值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解全球首款具備自動洗抹布功能的擦窗機器人，如何解決傳統擦窗反覆手洗抹布的痛點。
  • 掌握科沃斯在清潔領域的創新突破，包括高壓水噴洗、雙水箱設計與微米級貼邊清潔技術。
  • 全面解析一體化智慧基站的實用亮點，包含彩色觸控螢幕、雙抹布模組替換與電控自動收線功能。

摘要

引領市場的自動洗抹布擦窗旗艦

作者介紹了科沃斯（Ecovacs）推出的全能自動洗抹布擦窗機器人。科沃斯憑藉深厚的硬體研發與路徑演算法實力，在全球擦窗機市場享有超過五成份額的統治地位。針對過往擦窗機配件繁雜與需頻繁手洗抹布的難題，新一代旗艦機型正式導入了雙水箱自清潔基站，將窗戶清潔體驗推向全新高度。

高壓噴洗技術與雙模組無縫輪替

該設備內部搭載內建清水箱與污水箱，基站內建四組共12個複合清潔刷與刮條，轉速高達每分鐘200轉，並結合20,000 Pa高壓噴水模組，僅需約一分鐘即可徹底洗淨抹布並排乾多餘水分。最便利的是其配備了雙抹布模組，當一塊抹布清洗時，可立即換上另一塊繼續作業，既能實現不間斷清潔，又避免了反覆撕貼導致超細纖維布料磨損變形。

智慧彩色螢幕與極致貼邊清潔

新一代機身基站採用簡約質感外觀與透明清洗艙，並首度加入了彩色觸控螢幕，使用者無需仰賴手機即可快速切換快速、深度或邊緣清潔模式。針對邊角死角，機器配備了能深入框邊僅1毫米的渦輪邊刷技術，透過動態升降與高速旋轉刮除積灰。此外，基站還支援清洗艙自清潔與電控收線功能，大幅改善了傳統設備收納繁瑣的問題。

But. most importantly, Ecovacs is truly. serious about making these robots; for. instance, most window cleaners today. still require cables, safety ropes, and. messy accessories, making them. complicated to use. A few years ago,. Ecovacs leveraged its supply chain. advantages to achieve full integration,. packing the power cord, safety rope,. and accessories into a single station,. bringing the world's first window. cleaning robot with a base station. I. haven't unboxed this specific model yet. —it launched late last year, and. Ecovacs hasn't slowed down since. So. , how does it actually perform? Let’s. take a look together. First, let's get. straight to the point and look at the. automatic mop-washing system. As you. can see, the W2, just like a robot. vacuum and mop, has a built-in clean. water tank and a dirty water tank. inside the station. Fill the clean. water tank with fresh water; dirty. water is automatically collected into. the sewage tank, which you can simply. empty when finished. Press the button. on top, and the door unlocks.

automatically. Here is the highlight:. Ecovacs has added four large sets,. totaling 12 commercial-style cleaning. brushes, inside the unit. It’s not. just 12 simple brushes; Ecovacs uses a. composite design on each blade,. featuring five sets of brushes paired. with a plastic scraper. Furthermore,. each set of blades can reach a high. speed of 200 revolutions per minute. With this combination, the five brushes. can quickly scrub away grime while the. scraper removes dirty water in time,. preventing it from getting dirtier as. it cleans, achieving rapid scrubbing at. 100 points per minute. And we aren't. done yet; beyond scrubbing, Ecovacs. added a pressure-boosting module inside. , achieving a powerful water jet of up. to 20,000 Pa. Additionally, four. high-pressure nozzles are added to each. blade set. During the cleaning process,. dirt can be rinsed away. For example,. in our test, you can see this window. hasn't been cleaned in over six months,. resulting in a very dirty cloth. Now,. let's put it in for self-cleaning. Cleaning is finished; you see, it only. takes about a minute. Let me show you. the before and after. It mainly relies. on three steps. First, rinsing with a. 16-point high-pressure water jet. Second, high-speed scrubbing at 200 RPM. , and finally, using the scraper on the. blade to remove dirty water promptly to. avoid secondary pollution. The system. finally drains the mop for you, so. it’s at the right moisture level to. be attached and continue window. cleaning. The key question is, what. problem does automatic cleaning. actually solve? Simply put, one of the. pain points of window cleaning robots. is that the cleaning cloth gets dirty. So, you have to keep pulling it off to. wash it. Then, carefully align it back. to continue cleaning. That’s why I. previously suggested buying extra. cloths since they aren't expensive, so. you can swap them out and wash them all. at once for better efficiency. With. automatic cleaning, you no longer have. to run back and forth to the sink, peel. off the cloth, and align it again. Most. importantly, the W3 Omni provides you. with two mop modules, so you don't have. to wait for one to finish washing. before moving on. For instance, if this. one is dirty, just gently pull the. buttons with both hands; see, the whole. module comes off. We can place the. dirty module directly into the cleaning. station and start the automatic wash. Then, we can immediately attach the. other clean module, letting it start. right away to continue cleaning the. windows. Once it departs, a clean cloth. is ready, so it can be swapped. immediately upon its return. It’s. certainly convenient, and traditional. methods of repeatedly tearing off and. reattaching these microfiber materials. actually cause them to shrink and wear. out. So now, you just need to remove.

them once finished to air dry, saving. the hassle of repeated reattachment,. and the materials will last much longer. . Next, let’s take a look at the. other highlights. First, regarding the. design, the Ecovacs W3N station is. noticeably larger than the previous W2. Omni to accommodate the self-cleaning. function. However, it now features a. sleek, minimalist grey-black aesthetic,. and the transparent cleaning bay in. front gives the W3 a more futuristic. feel. Additionally, the W3 has shifted. to a side-mounted storage design; when. stowed away, it looks just like what. you see on screen. This is mainly. because the self-cleaning station takes. up quite a bit of room; if the robot. were stored inside as well, the total. volume would be a bit excessive. At. least it’s still portable enough to. move around the house, but I’m sure. you’ve spotted the main highlight—. that’s right, Ecovacs has added a. color screen to the W3 station. This. actually makes the entire user. experience significantly better. In the. past, if you wanted to switch cleaning. modes, you basically had to use the. mobile app, which was already. convenient enough. But now, you can. just use this screen to quickly select. the W 3's cleaning mode. For example,. if you're cleaning cabinets, walls, or. windows that aren't that dirty, you can. just choose the Quick mode. For. scenarios where you’d normally just. do a quick wipe with a rag, the Quick. mode handles it perfectly. If the. windows are very dirty, my personal. advice is to use the Quick mode first. to clear the surface dust, then follow. up with the Deep mode for a more. intensive pass, which is safer and. cleaner. Finally, I suggest using the. Edge mode; this has been a strong,. traditional feature of Ecovacs window. robots in recent years. In the past,. window robots mainly focused on. cleaning the central glass area, but. they couldn't quite reach the very. edges. To solve this, Ecovacs. introduced "Edge" turbo-cleaning. technology a few years ago. Simply put,. when it detects the window frame, the. system automatically lowers these blue. turbo side brushes to scrape off. dried-on dust at the edges using soft. rubber bristles spinning at 200 RPM. When it returns to the center, it. automatically lifts the turbo brushes. to avoid any cross-contamination. Furthermore, Ecovacs has achieved an. edge-cleaning distance of just 1mm, and. the turbine’s downward pressure has. been further increased. Simply put, for. window cleaning, I suggest using the. edge-cleaning mode and running it two. or three times to target accumulated. dirt. By the way, if these three modes. aren't enough, the W3 Omni can. definitely connect to the app to unlock. more features, including precise. cleaning, efficient cleaning, area.

cleaning, and spot cleaning. You can. even control the robot directly using. the app without any issues. I’ve. mapped out the paths for each mode. based on official data, so you can just. take a look at the chart I’ve made. The next highlight is that this screen. can also be used to control the device. For instance, in the auto-wash mode,. there is currently a standard wash. cycle of about one minute. If the mop. pads are really dirty, there is also a. 90-second enhanced deep-clean mode. Finally, you can find the self-cleaning. mode. When you finish your work, you. can take out the mop pads first and. then start the self-cleaning mode. The. system will then flush the entire. cleaning chamber. Honestly, with this. transparent front panel, you can see. the rinsing process directly; it’s. actually quite therapeutic. Just keep. in mind that after self-cleaning,. remember to leave the chamber door open. for ventilation, and it’s still. recommended to remove the mop pads to. air dry before storing them away. Next,. let’s talk about the most ingenious. part of the Ecovacs window cleaning. robot: the all-in-one station system. they pioneered. Traditional window. cleaners are often frustrating because. of the many long cords that are. difficult to tidy up after each use. As. you can see with the W3 Omni, Ecovacs. has integrated everything, with only. one cable running from the base station. to the main unit. And the best part is. that they’ve added an electronically. controlled cable storage system inside. the station. So, it automatically. dispenses exactly the length of cable. the robot needs. The best part is that. when you’re done, you just press a. button, and as you can see, the cable. retracts automatically. You really. can't go back once you've tried it. Most importantly, this 5.5-meter. heavy-duty cable not only transmits. power to drive the robot, but Ecovacs. has also wrapped it in three layers of. composite material, allowing it to. withstand 100kg of tension. So if the. robot unfortunately falls, it can hold. onto the robot and prevent it from. free-falling. Besides, the best thing. about the station is that older window. cleaners lacked large batteries and had. to be plugged in to work, which was. very troublesome if there were no. outlets nearby. With this station, you. can integrate a large battery directly. into it, allowing you to carry it. around to clean windows, walls, or. cabinets anywhere in the house without. any issues. According to official specs. , a single charge provides 130 minutes,. or over two hours of cleaning time. In. our actual testing, even with the. low-battery warning enabled, it reached. a maximum runtime of 1 hour and 40. minutes, leaving a 30-minute buffer so. you don't fully drain the battery. By. the way, the station's screen now.

displays the remaining battery life. directly. If you ever run out of power. or experience a power failure, the. WINBOT unit has a built-in protection. mechanism. The system immediately. activates 30 minutes of backup power,. stops moving, stays firmly attached to. the glass, and sounds a loud alert so. you can retrieve it quickly. Also, even. though it has a built-in battery, the. WINBOT can still be used while plugged. in. If you are more cautious or have. large windows to clean, you can plug it. in for peace of mind. Since we're on. the subject, I should talk about safety. . As ECOVACS 'flagship, the anti-fall. solution is very mature. Taking the W2. as an example, it has a total of 16. fall-prevention mechanisms. I'll focus. on the most important parts. First,. ECOVACS included the previously. mentioned 100kg impact-resistant safety. rope. This figure far exceeds the 80kg. of impact force the machine might. generate during a fall, and the WINBOT. unit itself is equipped with a gravity. accelerometer. If a fall actually. occurs, the system will automatically. lock the rope to prevent it from. dropping further. Combined with the. automatic design on the base, once you. place it on a flat surface, the WINBOT. stays firmly attached, delivering up to. 800N of suction force. The coolest part. is its strength; it can even lift an. entire table, yet when you pull the. handle, the suction automatically. releases—the experience is seamless. Even if it's not fully suctioned, the. heavy 10kg station unit won't just fly. away, thanks to the locking rope, the. 100 kg-rated safety cord, and the. station's 10kg counterweight. Along. with the suction cup on the bottom, the. entire defense system is very. comprehensive. If you are still worried. , the machine comes with a safety. tether that you can attach to something. like a table leg for total security. A. reminder: the base only suctions to. flat surfaces. If your home has. textured floor-to-ceiling windows,. small tiles with gaps, or full-coverage. carpet, it won't be able to stay. attached, so we recommend using the. safety tether. Alright, now that we've. covered the station, let's talk about. the hardware specifications. As Ecovacs. ' flagship window cleaning model,. they’ve equipped the Omni with a. brand-new suction system featuring a. 10,000 Pa capacity. Speaking of the. 10,000 Pa ultra-high suction, thanks to. a new noise-reduction design, we. measured the noise level at about 67 to. 68 dB from one meter away, which is. even quieter than the W2S Omni’s 69. dB, so those cleaning indoor walls will. also notice a quieter experience. Furthermore, the W3 Omni is also. equipped with a pneumatic pressure. compensation system. When the machine. detects insufficient suction, it. completes pressure compensation in just.

0.04 seconds, and through path. optimization, our tests show that even. with a corner hanging off the edge like. this, it still holds on securely. Regarding path planning, it features. Ecovacs 'new generation Win-SLAM 5.5.0. algorithm. The main improvement is a. significant increase in overall. operating efficiency. In terms of data,. the hardware allows for a maximum. movement speed of 16 cm per second. Compared to the previous generation's. 14 cm per second, the algorithm is now. more proactive in probing irregular. glass, using new strategies to handle. various shapes of glass, cabinets, and. walls to maximize cleaning coverage. For mobility, Ecovacs continues to use. its signature caterpillar track drive. design. We sprayed water directly onto. the glass to simulate rainy or foggy. conditions where friction might drop,. and our tests show the W 3’s tracks. remain stable and operate smoothly. However, as a safety precaution, we. still recommend avoiding the use of. window cleaning robots during heavy. rain or high humidity. Additionally,. the app includes a track cleaning. function; you can hold a cloth against. the tracks to help them self-clean,. preventing any loss of friction. Regarding essential obstacle-detection. hardware, the W3 Omni features physical. bumper strips on both sides; when. encountering protrusions like window. frames or handles, the W3 senses them. on contact—anything over 2mm is. detected, prompting it to stop and. recalculate its path. As we’ve. mentioned before, modern window. cleaning robots go beyond just windows; thanks to vastly improved fan. performance, most smooth surfaces like. marble, cabinets, or even flat concrete. walls are not a problem. Therefore, it. can cover everything from windows and. bathroom tiles to smooth wall surfaces. For frameless glass cleaning, Ecovacs. ’ flagship product is also equipped. with edge-detection sensors. When the. machine detects it is not suctioned. onto anything, it reacts within just. 0.02 seconds to stop moving. So we are. testing it at the hardest level, like. this scene with a tiny gap between two. panes; just look at the screen. It. stops immediately, so when used on. frameless glass, the system can. successfully detect it, retreat. instantly, and avoid falling. In terms. of cleaning, this generation of Ecovacs. features flagship-grade wide-angle. triple-nozzle modules at both the front. and rear. It can achieve high-pressure. spraying at up to 43,700 Pa. The device. body also has a built-in 80ml water. tank. You have two options for the tank. : if the glass is oily or very dirty,. it is recommended to use the original. robot-specific cleaning solution. If. you are cleaning indoors or on. furniture, you can just use tap water. A quick reminder: don't forget to fill.

it! Because the machine sprays mist. automatically while moving, besides. dissolving dirt and providing constant. hydration, it primarily reduces. friction between the microfiber and the. surface, lowering the risk of. scratching the glass. Basically, with. the built-in path algorithm, there. won't be issues with streaks, so don't. worry too much; it's actually leftover. grime that commonly leaves marks. As. for the level of cleanliness, just look. at the before and after on the screen. Just. Alright. We’ve tested window. cleaning robots many times; basically,. getting glass clean is a very mature,. fundamental skill—you could even use. a newspaper and get it clean. So,. flagship window cleaners primarily. compete on hardware components, path. algorithms, and whose software and. hardware design is more convenient and. user-friendly. I still need to be clear. : the current scope for these robots is. the kind of glass you could already. clean yourself at home. If it is. extremely dirty or has hard water. stains that require chemical agents,. that's beyond the scope of these robots. . We've reached the end of the show,. and overall, if I had to give buying. advice, honestly, I don't know the. price yet. If Ecovacs still sells it. for under 15,000, then you can go. straight for the W3N. But if it's. priced higher, I think for the average. household, the W2S, which is around. 10,000, is already good enough. Having. a base station really makes a huge. difference. But I still suggest buying. a window cleaner to share with a few. good friends to make it more. cost-effective. The W3 builds on the. W2S by significantly bumping up the. specs across the board. Plus, the. automatic cleaning and the screen on. the machine itself are really useful. It saves the time spent wetting,. wringing, and grabbing cleaning cloths. And you don't need to struggle with the. cloth's dampness; the machine handles. the control perfectly once washed. Just. attach it and go—it's much more. convenient. Plus, being able to operate. it directly on the screen is another. major highlight. In short, this is. currently the top-tier window cleaning. robot, bar none. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解全球首款具備自動洗抹布功能的擦窗機器人，如何解決傳統擦窗反覆手洗抹布的痛點。
  • 掌握科沃斯在清潔領域的創新突破，包括高壓水噴洗、雙水箱設計與微米級貼邊清潔技術。
  • 全面解析一體化智慧基站的實用亮點，包含彩色觸控螢幕、雙抹布模組替換與電控自動收線功能。

摘要

引領市場的自動洗抹布擦窗旗艦

作者介紹了科沃斯（Ecovacs）推出的全能自動洗抹布擦窗機器人。科沃斯憑藉深厚的硬體研發與路徑演算法實力，在全球擦窗機市場享有超過五成份額的統治地位。針對過往擦窗機配件繁雜與需頻繁手洗抹布的難題，新一代旗艦機型正式導入了雙水箱自清潔基站，將窗戶清潔體驗推向全新高度。

高壓噴洗技術與雙模組無縫輪替

該設備內部搭載內建清水箱與污水箱，基站內建四組共12個複合清潔刷與刮條，轉速高達每分鐘200轉，並結合20,000 Pa高壓噴水模組，僅需約一分鐘即可徹底洗淨抹布並排乾多餘水分。最便利的是其配備了雙抹布模組，當一塊抹布清洗時，可立即換上另一塊繼續作業，既能實現不間斷清潔，又避免了反覆撕貼導致超細纖維布料磨損變形。

智慧彩色螢幕與極致貼邊清潔

新一代機身基站採用簡約質感外觀與透明清洗艙，並首度加入了彩色觸控螢幕，使用者無需仰賴手機即可快速切換快速、深度或邊緣清潔模式。針對邊角死角，機器配備了能深入框邊僅1毫米的渦輪邊刷技術，透過動態升降與高速旋轉刮除積灰。此外，基站還支援清洗艙自清潔與電控收線功能，大幅改善了傳統設備收納繁瑣的問題。

================================================

That’s right, this is the world's. first all-in-one window cleaning robot. that can automatically wash its own mop. . Hi, welcome back. I'm Donkey. Basically, when it comes to window. cleaning robots, those who follow the. industry will naturally think of three. characters: Ecovacs. They’ve been. doing well globally, not just with. their floor cleaning robots and washing. machines, but their window cleaning. robots have always been a very strong. product line, often capturing 60%to 70%. of the market share. The point is, even. on a global scale, Ecovacs 'market. share is truly formidable. For example,. the well-known research firm IDC. reported in the first quarter of this. year that Ecovacs holds over 50%of the. global market share for window cleaning. robots, remaining the undisputed leader. . Honestly, it's no surprise at all; for one, Ecovacs invested in R&D for. window cleaning robots very early on. Secondly, the core principles of window. cleaners share the same DNA as the fan. hardware and path-planning algorithms. of floor cleaning robots. And that has. always been Ecovacs' specialty. But. most importantly, Ecovacs is truly. serious about making these robots; for. instance, most window cleaners today. still require cables, safety ropes, and. messy accessories, making them. complicated to use. A few years ago,. Ecovacs leveraged its supply chain. advantages to achieve full integration,. packing the power cord, safety rope,. and accessories into a single station,. bringing the world's first window. cleaning robot with a base station. I. haven't unboxed this specific model yet. —it launched late last year, and. Ecovacs hasn't slowed down since. Last. year, viewers were saying how great it. would be if a window cleaner could wash. its own mop. So, at CES in Las Vegas. earlier this year, we shared in our. robot community that Ecovacs had indeed. launched a flagship window cleaning. robot with automatic mop-washing. capabilities. Pretty interesting, right. ? By the way, for those who haven't. joined our robot community yet, we have. over 60,000 members sharing tips and. insights, so come join the discussion. and be sure to sign up. Back to the. show, so yes, what I have here is the. world's first window cleaning robot. with an automatic mop-washing feature:. the flagship Ecovacs Winbot W2 Omni. So. , how does it actually perform? Let’s. take a look together. First, let's get. straight to the point and look at the. automatic mop-washing system. As you. can see, the W2, just like a robot. vacuum and mop, has a built-in clean. water tank and a dirty water tank. inside the station. Fill the clean. water tank with fresh water; dirty. water is automatically collected into. the sewage tank, which you can simply. empty when finished. Press the button. on top, and the door unlocks.

automatically. Here is the highlight:. Ecovacs has added four large sets,. totaling 12 commercial-style cleaning. brushes, inside the unit. It’s not. just 12 simple brushes; Ecovacs uses a. composite design on each blade,. featuring five sets of brushes paired. with a plastic scraper. Furthermore,. each set of blades can reach a high. speed of 200 revolutions per minute. With this combination, the five brushes. can quickly scrub away grime while the. scraper removes dirty water in time,. preventing it from getting dirtier as. it cleans, achieving rapid scrubbing at. 100 points per minute. And we aren't. done yet; beyond scrubbing, Ecovacs. added a pressure-boosting module inside. , achieving a powerful water jet of up. to 20,000 Pa. Additionally, four. high-pressure nozzles are added to each. blade set. During the cleaning process,. dirt can be rinsed away. For example,. in our test, you can see this window. hasn't been cleaned in over six months,. resulting in a very dirty cloth. Now,. let's put it in for self-cleaning. Cleaning is finished; you see, it only. takes about a minute. Let me show you. the before and after. It mainly relies. on three steps. First, rinsing with a. 16-point high-pressure water jet. Second, high-speed scrubbing at 200 RPM. , and finally, using the scraper on the. blade to remove dirty water promptly to. avoid secondary pollution. The system. finally drains the mop for you, so. it’s at the right moisture level to. be attached and continue window. cleaning. The key question is, what. problem does automatic cleaning. actually solve? Simply put, one of the. pain points of window cleaning robots. is that the cleaning cloth gets dirty. So, you have to keep pulling it off to. wash it. Then, carefully align it back. to continue cleaning. That’s why I. previously suggested buying extra. cloths since they aren't expensive, so. you can swap them out and wash them all. at once for better efficiency. With. automatic cleaning, you no longer have. to run back and forth to the sink, peel. off the cloth, and align it again. Most. importantly, the W3 Omni provides you. with two mop modules, so you don't have. to wait for one to finish washing. before moving on. For instance, if this. one is dirty, just gently pull the. buttons with both hands; see, the whole. module comes off. We can place the. dirty module directly into the cleaning. station and start the automatic wash. Then, we can immediately attach the. other clean module, letting it start. right away to continue cleaning the. windows. Once it departs, a clean cloth. is ready, so it can be swapped. immediately upon its return. It’s. certainly convenient, and traditional. methods of repeatedly tearing off and. reattaching these microfiber materials. actually cause them to shrink and wear. out. So now, you just need to remove.

them once finished to air dry, saving. the hassle of repeated reattachment,. and the materials will last much longer. . Next, let’s take a look at the. other highlights. First, regarding the. design, the Ecovacs W3N station is. noticeably larger than the previous W2. Omni to accommodate the self-cleaning. function. However, it now features a. sleek, minimalist grey-black aesthetic,. and the transparent cleaning bay in. front gives the W3 a more futuristic. feel. Additionally, the W3 has shifted. to a side-mounted storage design; when. stowed away, it looks just like what. you see on screen. This is mainly. because the self-cleaning station takes. up quite a bit of room; if the robot. were stored inside as well, the total. volume would be a bit excessive. At. least it’s still portable enough to. move around the house, but I’m sure. you’ve spotted the main highlight—. that’s right, Ecovacs has added a. color screen to the W3 station. This. actually makes the entire user. experience significantly better. In the. past, if you wanted to switch cleaning. modes, you basically had to use the. mobile app, which was already. convenient enough. But now, you can. just use this screen to quickly select. the W 3's cleaning mode. For example,. if you're cleaning cabinets, walls, or. windows that aren't that dirty, you can. just choose the Quick mode. For. scenarios where you’d normally just. do a quick wipe with a rag, the Quick. mode handles it perfectly. If the. windows are very dirty, my personal. advice is to use the Quick mode first. to clear the surface dust, then follow. up with the Deep mode for a more. intensive pass, which is safer and. cleaner. Finally, I suggest using the. Edge mode; this has been a strong,. traditional feature of Ecovacs window. robots in recent years. In the past,. window robots mainly focused on. cleaning the central glass area, but. they couldn't quite reach the very. edges. To solve this, Ecovacs. introduced "Edge" turbo-cleaning. technology a few years ago. Simply put,. when it detects the window frame, the. system automatically lowers these blue. turbo side brushes to scrape off. dried-on dust at the edges using soft. rubber bristles spinning at 200 RPM. When it returns to the center, it. automatically lifts the turbo brushes. to avoid any cross-contamination. Furthermore, Ecovacs has achieved an. edge-cleaning distance of just 1mm, and. the turbine’s downward pressure has. been further increased. Simply put, for. window cleaning, I suggest using the. edge-cleaning mode and running it two. or three times to target accumulated. dirt. By the way, if these three modes. aren't enough, the W3 Omni can. definitely connect to the app to unlock. more features, including precise. cleaning, efficient cleaning, area.

cleaning, and spot cleaning. You can. even control the robot directly using. the app without any issues. I’ve. mapped out the paths for each mode. based on official data, so you can just. take a look at the chart I’ve made. The next highlight is that this screen. can also be used to control the device. For instance, in the auto-wash mode,. there is currently a standard wash. cycle of about one minute. If the mop. pads are really dirty, there is also a. 90-second enhanced deep-clean mode. Finally, you can find the self-cleaning. mode. When you finish your work, you. can take out the mop pads first and. then start the self-cleaning mode. The. system will then flush the entire. cleaning chamber. Honestly, with this. transparent front panel, you can see. the rinsing process directly; it’s. actually quite therapeutic. Just keep. in mind that after self-cleaning,. remember to leave the chamber door open. for ventilation, and it’s still. recommended to remove the mop pads to. air dry before storing them away. Next,. let’s talk about the most ingenious. part of the Ecovacs window cleaning. robot: the all-in-one station system. they pioneered. Traditional window. cleaners are often frustrating because. of the many long cords that are. difficult to tidy up after each use. As. you can see with the W3 Omni, Ecovacs. has integrated everything, with only. one cable running from the base station. to the main unit. And the best part is. that they’ve added an electronically. controlled cable storage system inside. the station. So, it automatically. dispenses exactly the length of cable. the robot needs. The best part is that. when you’re done, you just press a. button, and as you can see, the cable. retracts automatically. You really. can't go back once you've tried it. Most importantly, this 5.5-meter. heavy-duty cable not only transmits. power to drive the robot, but Ecovacs. has also wrapped it in three layers of. composite material, allowing it to. withstand 100kg of tension. So if the. robot unfortunately falls, it can hold. onto the robot and prevent it from. free-falling. Besides, the best thing. about the station is that older window. cleaners lacked large batteries and had. to be plugged in to work, which was. very troublesome if there were no. outlets nearby. With this station, you. can integrate a large battery directly. into it, allowing you to carry it. around to clean windows, walls, or. cabinets anywhere in the house without. any issues. According to official specs. , a single charge provides 130 minutes,. or over two hours of cleaning time. In. our actual testing, even with the. low-battery warning enabled, it reached. a maximum runtime of 1 hour and 40. minutes, leaving a 30-minute buffer so. you don't fully drain the battery. By. the way, the station's screen now.

displays the remaining battery life. directly. If you ever run out of power. or experience a power failure, the. WINBOT unit has a built-in protection. mechanism. The system immediately. activates 30 minutes of backup power,. stops moving, stays firmly attached to. the glass, and sounds a loud alert so. you can retrieve it quickly. Also, even. though it has a built-in battery, the. WINBOT can still be used while plugged. in. If you are more cautious or have. large windows to clean, you can plug it. in for peace of mind. Since we're on. the subject, I should talk about safety. . As ECOVACS 'flagship, the anti-fall. solution is very mature. Taking the W2. as an example, it has a total of 16. fall-prevention mechanisms. I'll focus. on the most important parts. First,. ECOVACS included the previously. mentioned 100kg impact-resistant safety. rope. This figure far exceeds the 80kg. of impact force the machine might. generate during a fall, and the WINBOT. unit itself is equipped with a gravity. accelerometer. If a fall actually. occurs, the system will automatically. lock the rope to prevent it from. dropping further. Combined with the. automatic design on the base, once you. place it on a flat surface, the WINBOT. stays firmly attached, delivering up to. 800N of suction force. The coolest part. is its strength; it can even lift an. entire table, yet when you pull the. handle, the suction automatically. releases—the experience is seamless. Even if it's not fully suctioned, the. heavy 10kg station unit won't just fly. away, thanks to the locking rope, the. 100 kg-rated safety cord, and the. station's 10kg counterweight. Along. with the suction cup on the bottom, the. entire defense system is very. comprehensive. If you are still worried. , the machine comes with a safety. tether that you can attach to something. like a table leg for total security. A. reminder: the base only suctions to. flat surfaces. If your home has. textured floor-to-ceiling windows,. small tiles with gaps, or full-coverage. carpet, it won't be able to stay. attached, so we recommend using the. safety tether. Alright, now that we've. covered the station, let's talk about. the hardware specifications. As Ecovacs. ' flagship window cleaning model,. they’ve equipped the Omni with a. brand-new suction system featuring a. 10,000 Pa capacity. Speaking of the. 10,000 Pa ultra-high suction, thanks to. a new noise-reduction design, we. measured the noise level at about 67 to. 68 dB from one meter away, which is. even quieter than the W2S Omni’s 69. dB, so those cleaning indoor walls will. also notice a quieter experience. Furthermore, the W3 Omni is also. equipped with a pneumatic pressure. compensation system. When the machine. detects insufficient suction, it. completes pressure compensation in just.

0.04 seconds, and through path. optimization, our tests show that even. with a corner hanging off the edge like. this, it still holds on securely. Regarding path planning, it features. Ecovacs 'new generation Win-SLAM 5.5.0. algorithm. The main improvement is a. significant increase in overall. operating efficiency. In terms of data,. the hardware allows for a maximum. movement speed of 16 cm per second. Compared to the previous generation's. 14 cm per second, the algorithm is now. more proactive in probing irregular. glass, using new strategies to handle. various shapes of glass, cabinets, and. walls to maximize cleaning coverage. For mobility, Ecovacs continues to use. its signature caterpillar track drive. design. We sprayed water directly onto. the glass to simulate rainy or foggy. conditions where friction might drop,. and our tests show the W 3’s tracks. remain stable and operate smoothly. However, as a safety precaution, we. still recommend avoiding the use of. window cleaning robots during heavy. rain or high humidity. Additionally,. the app includes a track cleaning. function; you can hold a cloth against. the tracks to help them self-clean,. preventing any loss of friction. Regarding essential obstacle-detection. hardware, the W3 Omni features physical. bumper strips on both sides; when. encountering protrusions like window. frames or handles, the W3 senses them. on contact—anything over 2mm is. detected, prompting it to stop and. recalculate its path. As we’ve. mentioned before, modern window. cleaning robots go beyond just windows; thanks to vastly improved fan. performance, most smooth surfaces like. marble, cabinets, or even flat concrete. walls are not a problem. Therefore, it. can cover everything from windows and. bathroom tiles to smooth wall surfaces. For frameless glass cleaning, Ecovacs. ’ flagship product is also equipped. with edge-detection sensors. When the. machine detects it is not suctioned. onto anything, it reacts within just. 0.02 seconds to stop moving. So we are. testing it at the hardest level, like. this scene with a tiny gap between two. panes; just look at the screen. It. stops immediately, so when used on. frameless glass, the system can. successfully detect it, retreat. instantly, and avoid falling. In terms. of cleaning, this generation of Ecovacs. features flagship-grade wide-angle. triple-nozzle modules at both the front. and rear. It can achieve high-pressure. spraying at up to 43,700 Pa. The device. body also has a built-in 80ml water. tank. You have two options for the tank. : if the glass is oily or very dirty,. it is recommended to use the original. robot-specific cleaning solution. If. you are cleaning indoors or on. furniture, you can just use tap water. A quick reminder: don't forget to fill.

it! Because the machine sprays mist. automatically while moving, besides. dissolving dirt and providing constant. hydration, it primarily reduces. friction between the microfiber and the. surface, lowering the risk of. scratching the glass. Basically, with. the built-in path algorithm, there. won't be issues with streaks, so don't. worry too much; it's actually leftover. grime that commonly leaves marks. As. for the level of cleanliness, just look. at the before and after on the screen. Just. Alright. We’ve tested window. cleaning robots many times; basically,. getting glass clean is a very mature,. fundamental skill—you could even use. a newspaper and get it clean. So,. flagship window cleaners primarily. compete on hardware components, path. algorithms, and whose software and. hardware design is more convenient and. user-friendly. I still need to be clear. : the current scope for these robots is. the kind of glass you could already. clean yourself at home. If it is. extremely dirty or has hard water. stains that require chemical agents,. that's beyond the scope of these robots. . We've reached the end of the show,. and overall, if I had to give buying. advice, honestly, I don't know the. price yet. If Ecovacs still sells it. for under 15,000, then you can go. straight for the W3N. But if it's. priced higher, I think for the average. household, the W2S, which is around. 10,000, is already good enough. Having. a base station really makes a huge. difference. But I still suggest buying. a window cleaner to share with a few. good friends to make it more. cost-effective. The W3 builds on the. W2S by significantly bumping up the. specs across the board. Plus, the. automatic cleaning and the screen on. the machine itself are really useful. It saves the time spent wetting,. wringing, and grabbing cleaning cloths. And you don't need to struggle with the. cloth's dampness; the machine handles. the control perfectly once washed. Just. attach it and go—it's much more. convenient. Plus, being able to operate. it directly on the screen is another. major highlight. In short, this is. currently the top-tier window cleaning. robot, bar none. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OjBWQOZq8Oc

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解全球首款具備自動洗抹布功能的擦窗機器人，如何解決傳統擦窗反覆手洗抹布的痛點。
  • 掌握科沃斯在清潔領域的創新突破，包括高壓水噴洗、雙水箱設計與微米級貼邊清潔技術。
  • 全面解析一體化智慧基站的實用亮點，包含彩色觸控螢幕、雙抹布模組替換與電控自動收線功能。

摘要

引領市場的自動洗抹布擦窗旗艦

作者介紹了科沃斯（Ecovacs）推出的全能自動洗抹布擦窗機器人。科沃斯憑藉深厚的硬體研發與路徑演算法實力，在全球擦窗機市場享有超過五成份額的統治地位。針對過往擦窗機配件繁雜與需頻繁手洗抹布的難題，新一代旗艦機型正式導入了雙水箱自清潔基站，將窗戶清潔體驗推向全新高度。

高壓噴洗技術與雙模組無縫輪替

該設備內部搭載內建清水箱與污水箱，基站內建四組共12個複合清潔刷與刮條，轉速高達每分鐘200轉，並結合20,000 Pa高壓噴水模組，僅需約一分鐘即可徹底洗淨抹布並排乾多餘水分。最便利的是其配備了雙抹布模組，當一塊抹布清洗時，可立即換上另一塊繼續作業，既能實現不間斷清潔，又避免了反覆撕貼導致超細纖維布料磨損變形。

智慧彩色螢幕與極致貼邊清潔

新一代機身基站採用簡約質感外觀與透明清洗艙，並首度加入了彩色觸控螢幕，使用者無需仰賴手機即可快速切換快速、深度或邊緣清潔模式。針對邊角死角，機器配備了能深入框邊僅1毫米的渦輪邊刷技術，透過動態升降與高速旋轉刮除積灰。此外，基站還支援清洗艙自清潔與電控收線功能，大幅改善了傳統設備收納繁瑣的問題。

================================================

That’s right, this is the world's. first all-in-one window cleaning robot. that can automatically wash its own mop. . Hi, welcome back. I'm Donkey. Basically, when it comes to window. cleaning robots, those who follow the. industry will naturally think of three. characters: Ecovacs. They’ve been. doing well globally, not just with. their floor cleaning robots and washing. machines, but their window cleaning. robots have always been a very strong. product line, often capturing 60%to 70%. of the market share. The point is, even. on a global scale, Ecovacs 'market. share is truly formidable. For example,. the well-known research firm IDC. reported in the first quarter of this. year that Ecovacs holds over 50%of the. global market share for window cleaning. robots, remaining the undisputed leader. . Honestly, it's no surprise at all; for one, Ecovacs invested in R&D for. window cleaning robots very early on. Secondly, the core principles of window. cleaners share the same DNA as the fan. hardware and path-planning algorithms. of floor cleaning robots. And that has. always been Ecovacs' specialty. But. most importantly, Ecovacs is truly. serious about making these robots; for. instance, most window cleaners today. still require cables, safety ropes, and. messy accessories, making them. complicated to use. A few years ago,. Ecovacs leveraged its supply chain. advantages to achieve full integration,. packing the power cord, safety rope,. and accessories into a single station,. bringing the world's first window. cleaning robot with a base station. I. haven't unboxed this specific model yet. —it launched late last year, and. Ecovacs hasn't slowed down since. Last. year, viewers were saying how great it. would be if a window cleaner could wash. its own mop. So, at CES in Las Vegas. earlier this year, we shared in our. robot community that Ecovacs had indeed. launched a flagship window cleaning. robot with automatic mop-washing. capabilities. Pretty interesting, right. ? By the way, for those who haven't. joined our robot community yet, we have. over 60,000 members sharing tips and. insights, so come join the discussion. and be sure to sign up. Back to the. show, so yes, what I have here is the. world's first window cleaning robot. with an automatic mop-washing feature:. the flagship Ecovacs Winbot W2 Omni. So. , how does it actually perform? Let’s. take a look together. First, let's get. straight to the point and look at the. automatic mop-washing system. As you. can see, the W2, just like a robot. vacuum and mop, has a built-in clean. water tank and a dirty water tank. inside the station. Fill the clean. water tank with fresh water; dirty. water is automatically collected into. the sewage tank, which you can simply. empty when finished. Press the button. on top, and the door unlocks.

automatically. Here is the highlight:. Ecovacs has added four large sets,. totaling 12 commercial-style cleaning. brushes, inside the unit. It’s not. just 12 simple brushes; Ecovacs uses a. composite design on each blade,. featuring five sets of brushes paired. with a plastic scraper. Furthermore,. each set of blades can reach a high. speed of 200 revolutions per minute. With this combination, the five brushes. can quickly scrub away grime while the. scraper removes dirty water in time,. preventing it from getting dirtier as. it cleans, achieving rapid scrubbing at. 100 points per minute. And we aren't. done yet; beyond scrubbing, Ecovacs. added a pressure-boosting module inside. , achieving a powerful water jet of up. to 20,000 Pa. Additionally, four. high-pressure nozzles are added to each. blade set. During the cleaning process,. dirt can be rinsed away. For example,. in our test, you can see this window. hasn't been cleaned in over six months,. resulting in a very dirty cloth. Now,. let's put it in for self-cleaning. Cleaning is finished; you see, it only. takes about a minute. Let me show you. the before and after. It mainly relies. on three steps. First, rinsing with a. 16-point high-pressure water jet. Second, high-speed scrubbing at 200 RPM. , and finally, using the scraper on the. blade to remove dirty water promptly to. avoid secondary pollution. The system. finally drains the mop for you, so. it’s at the right moisture level to. be attached and continue window. cleaning. The key question is, what. problem does automatic cleaning. actually solve? Simply put, one of the. pain points of window cleaning robots. is that the cleaning cloth gets dirty. So, you have to keep pulling it off to. wash it. Then, carefully align it back. to continue cleaning. That’s why I. previously suggested buying extra. cloths since they aren't expensive, so. you can swap them out and wash them all. at once for better efficiency. With. automatic cleaning, you no longer have. to run back and forth to the sink, peel. off the cloth, and align it again. Most. importantly, the W3 Omni provides you. with two mop modules, so you don't have. to wait for one to finish washing. before moving on. For instance, if this. one is dirty, just gently pull the. buttons with both hands; see, the whole. module comes off. We can place the. dirty module directly into the cleaning. station and start the automatic wash. Then, we can immediately attach the. other clean module, letting it start. right away to continue cleaning the. windows. Once it departs, a clean cloth. is ready, so it can be swapped. immediately upon its return. It’s. certainly convenient, and traditional. methods of repeatedly tearing off and. reattaching these microfiber materials. actually cause them to shrink and wear. out. So now, you just need to remove.

them once finished to air dry, saving. the hassle of repeated reattachment,. and the materials will last much longer. . Next, let’s take a look at the. other highlights. First, regarding the. design, the Ecovacs W3N station is. noticeably larger than the previous W2. Omni to accommodate the self-cleaning. function. However, it now features a. sleek, minimalist grey-black aesthetic,. and the transparent cleaning bay in. front gives the W3 a more futuristic. feel. Additionally, the W3 has shifted. to a side-mounted storage design; when. stowed away, it looks just like what. you see on screen. This is mainly. because the self-cleaning station takes. up quite a bit of room; if the robot. were stored inside as well, the total. volume would be a bit excessive. At. least it’s still portable enough to. move around the house, but I’m sure. you’ve spotted the main highlight—. that’s right, Ecovacs has added a. color screen to the W3 station. This. actually makes the entire user. experience significantly better. In the. past, if you wanted to switch cleaning. modes, you basically had to use the. mobile app, which was already. convenient enough. But now, you can. just use this screen to quickly select. the W 3's cleaning mode. For example,. if you're cleaning cabinets, walls, or. windows that aren't that dirty, you can. just choose the Quick mode. For. scenarios where you’d normally just. do a quick wipe with a rag, the Quick. mode handles it perfectly. If the. windows are very dirty, my personal. advice is to use the Quick mode first. to clear the surface dust, then follow. up with the Deep mode for a more. intensive pass, which is safer and. cleaner. Finally, I suggest using the. Edge mode; this has been a strong,. traditional feature of Ecovacs window. robots in recent years. In the past,. window robots mainly focused on. cleaning the central glass area, but. they couldn't quite reach the very. edges. To solve this, Ecovacs. introduced "Edge" turbo-cleaning. technology a few years ago. Simply put,. when it detects the window frame, the. system automatically lowers these blue. turbo side brushes to scrape off. dried-on dust at the edges using soft. rubber bristles spinning at 200 RPM. When it returns to the center, it. automatically lifts the turbo brushes. to avoid any cross-contamination. Furthermore, Ecovacs has achieved an. edge-cleaning distance of just 1mm, and. the turbine’s downward pressure has. been further increased. Simply put, for. window cleaning, I suggest using the. edge-cleaning mode and running it two. or three times to target accumulated. dirt. By the way, if these three modes. aren't enough, the W3 Omni can. definitely connect to the app to unlock. more features, including precise. cleaning, efficient cleaning, area.

cleaning, and spot cleaning. You can. even control the robot directly using. the app without any issues. I’ve. mapped out the paths for each mode. based on official data, so you can just. take a look at the chart I’ve made. The next highlight is that this screen. can also be used to control the device. For instance, in the auto-wash mode,. there is currently a standard wash. cycle of about one minute. If the mop. pads are really dirty, there is also a. 90-second enhanced deep-clean mode. Finally, you can find the self-cleaning. mode. When you finish your work, you. can take out the mop pads first and. then start the self-cleaning mode. The. system will then flush the entire. cleaning chamber. Honestly, with this. transparent front panel, you can see. the rinsing process directly; it’s. actually quite therapeutic. Just keep. in mind that after self-cleaning,. remember to leave the chamber door open. for ventilation, and it’s still. recommended to remove the mop pads to. air dry before storing them away. Next,. let’s talk about the most ingenious. part of the Ecovacs window cleaning. robot: the all-in-one station system. they pioneered. Traditional window. cleaners are often frustrating because. of the many long cords that are. difficult to tidy up after each use. As. you can see with the W3 Omni, Ecovacs. has integrated everything, with only. one cable running from the base station. to the main unit. And the best part is. that they’ve added an electronically. controlled cable storage system inside. the station. So, it automatically. dispenses exactly the length of cable. the robot needs. The best part is that. when you’re done, you just press a. button, and as you can see, the cable. retracts automatically. You really. can't go back once you've tried it. Most importantly, this 5.5-meter. heavy-duty cable not only transmits. power to drive the robot, but Ecovacs. has also wrapped it in three layers of. composite material, allowing it to. withstand 100kg of tension. So if the. robot unfortunately falls, it can hold. onto the robot and prevent it from. free-falling. item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=80vJX0KDYCQ

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入分析 iPhone 18 Pro 系列在面板供應鏈中的「螢幕抽獎」實況與頂級三星面板表現。
  • 詳解縮小版動態島與首度導入的「螢幕下 Face ID」設計，揭露左上角時間顯示模糊的真實原因。
  • 透過專業儀器實測螢幕全螢幕亮度、峰值亮度、色域覆蓋，以及色溫轉向 7200K 冷白調校的影響。

摘要

選購考量與面板供應分析

作者表示，隨著蘋果秋季發表會落幕，消費者的核心問題落在是否升級 iPhone 18 Pro 系列，亦或是回頭購買上一代旗艦。在螢幕面板方面，本代由三星與 LG 瓜分，作者實測的 18 Pro 與 18 Pro Max 均幸運抽中評價極高的三星 G9N 面板。在基礎規格上，兩款機種像素密度皆維持在標準的 460 ppi，出廠自帶的抗反射塗層表現則與前代相仿，一旦貼上一般保護貼便會失去抗反光優勢。

動態島微縮與螢幕下 Face ID 機制

本代螢幕最顯著的升級為動態島體積縮小，讓螢幕頂部能顯示更多即時內容，例如播放音樂時可同步顯示倒數計時器。然而，為了縮減膠囊面積，蘋果將 Face ID 感測模組移至螢幕左上角，並藉由降低該區塊的像素密度以達成螢幕下辨識。雖然臉部解鎖體驗依然順暢，但較低的像素密度導致左上角的「小時」數字顯示略顯模糊，且使用者在臥床使用或挑選霧面保護貼時需特別注意遮擋與相容性問題。

亮度輸出與全新冷色溫調校

在螢幕亮度實測環節，作者指出蘋果的表現相對保守，18 Pro Max 的全螢幕高亮度測得約 1,059 尼特，對比主流安卓旗艦動輒 1,500 尼特以上顯得稍顯不足，而峰值亮度則落在約 3,000 尼特，足以應付 HDR 內容播放。色彩表現方面，螢幕依舊具備近 99% 的 sRGB 與 90% 以上的 P3 色域覆蓋；但蘋果將螢幕相關色溫從過往偏暖的 D65 標準調整為偏冷白的 7200K，使肉眼觀看時呈現出更為清晰偏藍的冷色調視覺感。

================================================

As everyone knows, the September Apple. event has concluded, so it's quite. simple this year: should you upgrade to. the iPhone 18 Pro or the 18 Pro Max? If. you are currently hesitating between. the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max,. or whether you should go back and pick. up a 17 Pro Max, you definitely. shouldn't miss this episode. Hi,. welcome back, I'm Donkey. The initial. sales figures for this year's iPhone. launch are in. As expected, the most. sought-after model is the blue iPhone. 18 Pro Max in the mainstream storage. capacity. As for other models,. especially the Pro versions, there is. currently stock available at various. retailers, with even slight price drops. , so feel free to shop around. Since. there is no standard iPhone 18 this. year, the purchasing discussion is. relatively straightforward: whether or. not to upgrade to the iPhone 18 Pro. series. And if you do upgrade, how. exactly should you choose between the. two 18 Pro models? Or is rushing back. to pick up a 17 Pro Max actually the. better choice? So today, we are going. to complete the hands-on testing of the. iPhone 18 Pro series, and bring out all. our flagship Androids, including. Samsung's S26 Ultra, Google's latest. Pixel 11 Pro XL, Vivo's current. top-tier X300 Ultra, OPPO's flagship. FX9 Ultra, and Xiaomi's top. Leica-branded phone for a big showdown. How does the camera performance of the. iPhone 18 Pro series hold up this year? Ready? Let's go. As usual, our first. focus will be on the screen performance. test. By the way, we won't repeat what. we've already covered in previous. videos; this episode will focus. primarily on the test results. For. those who want to see the details,. please make sure to watch our previous. iPhone 18 Pro series videos. Right,. back to the topic: this year's iPhone. 18 Pro series screens are primarily. supplied by Samsung and LG, with. Samsung remaining the main provider for. the top-tier panels. Additionally, BOE. is not participating in the iPhone 18. Pro screen supply this year, so it's. simple: what you get this year is. either a Samsung or an LG. So let's. discuss: according to our screen checks. , both our iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. units got Samsung screens, and they are. the rumored superior Samsung G9N. versions. This is likely the best " screen lottery" result for an iPhone in. recent years. Before we jump into the. tests, don't forget to subscribe and. help us out. Subscribing is completely. free, but it really means a lot to us. As we have said many times regarding. screen testing, to judge the quality of. a modern OLED display in the Apple camp. , we mainly look at three indicators:. resolution, brightness, and color. rendering. Let's start with resolution. In recent years, iPhones have been very. straightforward. Whether you choose the. iPhone 18 Pro, 18 Pro Max, or last. year’s 17 Pro or 17 Pro Max, the. pixel density for all four models is. identical at 460 ppi. So, in terms of. screen sharpness, they perform. essentially the same; there's no need. to overthink it. Furthermore, Apple has. applied a basic anti-reflective. treatment to the iPhone 18 Pro series. right out of the factory. Under indoor. lighting, it appears clearer compared. to older models. However, according to. our tests, the anti-reflective effect.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入分析 iPhone 18 Pro 系列在面板供應鏈中的「螢幕抽獎」實況與頂級三星面板表現。
  • 詳解縮小版動態島與首度導入的「螢幕下 Face ID」設計，揭露左上角時間顯示模糊的真實原因。
  • 透過專業儀器實測螢幕全螢幕亮度、峰值亮度、色域覆蓋，以及色溫轉向 7200K 冷白調校的影響。

摘要

選購考量與面板供應分析

作者表示，隨著蘋果秋季發表會落幕，消費者的核心問題落在是否升級 iPhone 18 Pro 系列，亦或是回頭購買上一代旗艦。在螢幕面板方面，本代由三星與 LG 瓜分，作者實測的 18 Pro 與 18 Pro Max 均幸運抽中評價極高的三星 G9N 面板。在基礎規格上，兩款機種像素密度皆維持在標準的 460 ppi，出廠自帶的抗反射塗層表現則與前代相仿，一旦貼上一般保護貼便會失去抗反光優勢。

動態島微縮與螢幕下 Face ID 機制

本代螢幕最顯著的升級為動態島體積縮小，讓螢幕頂部能顯示更多即時內容，例如播放音樂時可同步顯示倒數計時器。然而，為了縮減膠囊面積，蘋果將 Face ID 感測模組移至螢幕左上角，並藉由降低該區塊的像素密度以達成螢幕下辨識。雖然臉部解鎖體驗依然順暢，但較低的像素密度導致左上角的「小時」數字顯示略顯模糊，且使用者在臥床使用或挑選霧面保護貼時需特別注意遮擋與相容性問題。

亮度輸出與全新冷色溫調校

在螢幕亮度實測環節，作者指出蘋果的表現相對保守，18 Pro Max 的全螢幕高亮度測得約 1,059 尼特，對比主流安卓旗艦動輒 1,500 尼特以上顯得稍顯不足，而峰值亮度則落在約 3,000 尼特，足以應付 HDR 內容播放。色彩表現方面，螢幕依舊具備近 99% 的 sRGB 與 90% 以上的 P3 色域覆蓋；但蘋果將螢幕相關色溫從過往偏暖的 D65 標準調整為偏冷白的 7200K，使肉眼觀看時呈現出更為清晰偏藍的冷色調視覺感。

================================================

Photographic Styles, where we can now.

find a brand-new texture option. Once. inside, we can select the intensity of. the softening effect, along with other. adjustable settings like glow, filmic,. and grain. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=80vJX0KDYCQ

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入分析 iPhone 18 Pro 系列在面板供應鏈中的「螢幕抽獎」實況與頂級三星面板表現。
  • 詳解縮小版動態島與首度導入的「螢幕下 Face ID」設計，揭露左上角時間顯示模糊的真實原因。
  • 透過專業儀器實測螢幕全螢幕亮度、峰值亮度、色域覆蓋，以及色溫轉向 7200K 冷白調校的影響。

摘要

選購考量與面板供應分析

作者表示，隨著蘋果秋季發表會落幕，消費者的核心問題落在是否升級 iPhone 18 Pro 系列，亦或是回頭購買上一代旗艦。在螢幕面板方面，本代由三星與 LG 瓜分，作者實測的 18 Pro 與 18 Pro Max 均幸運抽中評價極高的三星 G9N 面板。在基礎規格上，兩款機種像素密度皆維持在標準的 460 ppi，出廠自帶的抗反射塗層表現則與前代相仿，一旦貼上一般保護貼便會失去抗反光優勢。

動態島微縮與螢幕下 Face ID 機制

本代螢幕最顯著的升級為動態島體積縮小，讓螢幕頂部能顯示更多即時內容，例如播放音樂時可同步顯示倒數計時器。然而，為了縮減膠囊面積，蘋果將 Face ID 感測模組移至螢幕左上角，並藉由降低該區塊的像素密度以達成螢幕下辨識。雖然臉部解鎖體驗依然順暢，但較低的像素密度導致左上角的「小時」數字顯示略顯模糊，且使用者在臥床使用或挑選霧面保護貼時需特別注意遮擋與相容性問題。

亮度輸出與全新冷色溫調校

在螢幕亮度實測環節，作者指出蘋果的表現相對保守，18 Pro Max 的全螢幕高亮度測得約 1,059 尼特，對比主流安卓旗艦動輒 1,500 尼特以上顯得稍顯不足，而峰值亮度則落在約 3,000 尼特，足以應付 HDR 內容播放。色彩表現方面，螢幕依舊具備近 99% 的 sRGB 與 90% 以上的 P3 色域覆蓋；但蘋果將螢幕相關色溫從過往偏暖的 D65 標準調整為偏冷白的 7200K，使肉眼觀看時呈現出更為清晰偏藍的冷色調視覺感。

================================================

If. you are currently hesitating between. the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max,. or whether you should go back and pick. up a 17 Pro Max, you definitely. shouldn't miss this episode. Subscribing is completely. free, but it really means a lot to us. As we have said many times regarding. screen testing, to judge the quality of. a modern OLED display in the Apple camp. , we mainly look at three indicators:. resolution, brightness, and color. rendering. of the 18 Pro is basically the same as. the previous 17 Pro generation. Dynamic Island has successfully " slimmed down" and shrunk in size. This. change has two advantages and one. disadvantage; let’s talk about the. advantages first. With the Dynamic. Island shrinking, the display area. around the Dynamic Island on the iPhone. 18 Pro is larger than before. And that. larger area means the Dynamic Island. can now display more information. Dynamic Island is playing music, it can. also fit a countdown timer display next. to it, making it truly more useful. So,. what is the disadvantage? The principle is. simple: Apple reduced the density of. that section of the screen, allowing. the sensor to achieve better light. transmission for normal facial. recognition. ID transmitter module for this. generation still projects from the. middle of the screen. What it projects. onto your face is still the familiar. dot pattern, though the intensity has. changed. But overall, my. personal assessment of this change is. that the benefits outweigh the. drawbacks. Next, let's look at the. second screen metric: brightness. Max could reach 1,179 nits—nearly. 1,200 nits—in full-screen. high-brightness mode, while this year's. 18 Pro Max is down to only 1,059 nits. However, the 18 Pro maintains last. year's level at 1,196 nits. So, how. should we interpret these numbers? Anyway, we've talked. enough about performance, so we won't. waste your time further—just know. that the A20 Pro is a beast. If they. put this chip into a MacBook, it would. definitely be a bestseller. Now for the. third point: let's talk about battery. life. This year, we’ve broken it down. into three categories: video streaming,. recording, and gaming. First, for video. playback, one hour of YouTube 1080p. streaming consumed 4%on the iPhone 18. Pro. The 18 Pro Max used 3%. The 17 Pro. Max used 3%; low-demand scenarios. remain Apple's forte. Under the heavier. load of 4K 60fps Vision video recording. for half an hour, the iPhone 18 Pro. consumed 14%. The 18 Pro Max consumed 8. %. Last year's 17 Pro Max used a bit. more, coming in at 9%. Finally, for. half an hour of Honkai: Star Rail at. max graphics and effects, the 18 Pro. consumed 11%. The 18 Pro Max consumed 9. %. Last year's 17 Pro Max used 10%. So,. as you can clearly see from the tests. above, the 18 Pro Max battery has. improved by about 10%, leading to a. noticeable boost in battery life. However, looking at the specs overall,. the battery capacity of this year's. smaller 18 Pro isn't much different. from last year's 17 Pro, upgrading from. 3,988 mAh to 4,056 mAh. Therefore,. there isn't a significant difference in. the already excellent low-to-medium. demand battery life for the 18 Pro. But. for the iPhone 18 Pro Max, the capacity. increase is quite noticeable, jumping. from last year's 4,823 mAh to 5,391 mAh. . The main reason for this capacity. increase is that Apple switched to the. steel-cased battery on the 18 Pro Max,. which they previously tested on the 17. Pro. So, looking at the 17 Pro and 18. Pro, since they already used.

higher-density steel-cased batteries,. the capacity difference is minimal. However, the 17 Pro Max and 18 Pro Max. switched from traditional designs to. higher-density steel-cased batteries,. resulting in about a 10%increase in. capacity. This is also one of the. reasons for the weight increase, so. it's worth noting that while the. battery is larger, the 18 Pro Max is. truly heavy. The bare device alone is. 249 grams; add a screen protector and a. case, and you're over 300 grams,. officially joining the "half-pound club. ." The fourth point, let's look at. charging. This is where I feel the. iPhone 18 Pro series has the most. noticeable upgrade this year. Apple. actually upgraded to a 40W protocol. last year, but in our testing, while. the protocol was upgraded, the overall. charging speed remained relatively slow. and didn't really pick up. This year,. Apple has finally pushed the fast. charging speed of the 18 Pro series to. a 60W protocol. Using Apple's official. 40 W-to-60W dynamic charger, the peak. can reach around 50W. However, as we've. said, looking at peak wattage in. charging isn't very meaningful; looking. at the actual charging time is more. accurate. So we ran a charging test. directly. Our tests show that this. year's two 18 Pro models both reach. around 50%in just 15 minutes—. specifically, the 18 Pro Max at 49%and. the 18 Pro at 50%, both extremely fast. In just half an hour, they can charge. up to 79%for the 18 Pro Max and 81%for. the 18 Pro. A full charge takes only. one hour for the 18 Pro Max and 57. minutes for the 18 Pro, both very fast. This improvement is truly noticeable; if you forget to charge, just 15 to 20. minutes gives you enough power for. several hours. Next, we reach the main. event for today. Regarding the camera. this year, these three models are. actually very easy to compare. First,. in terms of lens specs, the 18 Pro, 18. Pro Max, and last year’s 17 Pro Max. all feature the same 1/1.28-inch main. lens, the same 1/2.55-inch 4x optical. zoom lens, and the same 1/2.55-inch. ultra-wide macro lens. However, even. though the main specs look the same,. many people haven't noticed that the. sensor on the new iPhone 18 Pro has. actually changed. For instance, on the. main camera, Apple secretly swapped in. a new-generation Sony-customized IMX905. sensor. Plus, they added the variable. aperture hardware everyone already. knows about, along with the "Pro. Control" software that acts like a. manual mode. For these details, please. refer to our last video, where we. covered them in more depth. Overall,. the camera updates this year, including. the variable aperture and Pro control. features, have indeed made photography. much more enjoyable. However, the. overall shooting experience hasn't. fundamentally pulled away from previous. generations. Especially regarding the. lens flare issue everyone cares about,. it remains unresolved in this. generation, with ghosting being even. slightly more noticeable—we already. compared it with the S26, where light. spots turned into halos. This was. somewhat unexpected. But truthfully,. there are still two changes in this. generation that I find well worth. noting. First, Apple has finally added. a beauty-like feature within the. Photographic Styles, where we can now.

find a brand-new texture option. Once. inside, we can select the intensity of. the softening effect, along with other. adjustable settings like glow, filmic,. and grain. However, what actually. attracts me most this time isn't the. softening, but that Apple has added. post-processing Cinematic mode features. . Simply put, Cinematic mode allows the. system to perform real-time. depth-of-field calculations while. recording, giving you a depth effect. similar to a DSLR. In the past, to. capture this kind of footage, you had. to select Cinematic mode beforehand. Now, you don't need those steps at all; for instance, using the main lens, I. can just start recording directly. After recording, we go into the Photos. app, and a "Cinematic" button appears. in the top left corner; once toggled,. the regular video instantly gains a. cinematic depth effect, supporting up. to 4K60, which is extremely practical. Alright, without further ado, we've. prepared the iPhone 18 Pro, 18 Pro Max,. and 17 Pro Max to compare against the. Samsung S26 Ultra, Google Pixel 11 Pro. XL, Vivo X300 Ultra, OPPO 5X9 Ultra,. and the Leica-branded Xiaomi. Here are. plenty of sample shots for everyone to. see. Hey. Next, let's look at the. Android phones from recent years. Hey. Hey. Hey. Hey. Lastly, we also provide. video samples. Coming up. We've reached. the final point: buying advice. So,. going back to the original question,. how exactly should you choose between. the 18 Pro, 18 Pro Max, and 17 Pro Max? My assessment of this year's iPhone 18. Dynamic Island has shrunk, and the. camera now includes a variable aperture. along with various useful software. supports. When you pick it up, you can. still feel the exceptional software and. hardware integration of Apple's Pro. series. But at the same time, I don't. know why, but the 18 Pro feels like a. polished work intended to pave the way. for the next-generation 20. th-anniversary iPhone. So, back to the. buying recommendation: if you are using. an iPhone 15 Pro series or earlier—. the "Snapdragon/hot" generation—then. upgrading to the 18 Pro series will. definitely be a noticeable improvement.
