item.title: 「邦尼評測」親民筆電處理器 2026？記憶體狂漲！ASUS Vivobook S16 完整評測（Intel Core 7 350、144Hz 螢幕、金屬機身、Xe3 華碩16吋辦公輕薄筆電值不值得買？
item.itunes:title: 「邦尼評測」親民筆電處理器 2026？記憶體狂漲！ASUS Vivobook S16 完整評測（Intel Core 7 350、144Hz 螢幕、金屬機身、Xe3 華碩16吋辦公輕薄筆電值不值得買？
item.itunes:author: 邦尼幫你 3C 科技 - 開箱評測
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QhKhGuCjcYM

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解記憶體與 SSD 漲價潮下，2026 年筆電市場及開學季促銷的現況。
  • 從機身、螢幕、鍵盤到連接埠，掌握 ASUS Vivobook S 16 作為文書筆電的實用設計與取捨。
  • 看看新一代 Intel 入門處理器與 Xe2 內顯的表現，以及影片展示的遊戲與跑分結果。

摘要

漲價環境下的筆電選擇

作者表示，2026 年記憶體、SSD 等電子零組件價格持續上漲，過去「不買就會降價」的說法似乎已不再適用。他認為電腦需求仍然存在，尤其開學季仍有品牌推出優惠，因此準備介紹兩款 ASUS 筆電：一款約新台幣四萬元的 16 吋 Vivobook S 16，以及約兩萬元的 14 吋入門文書機。本次評測主要聚焦在 Vivobook S 16。

新處理器與入門遊戲能力

作者介紹新一代 Intel Core 系列處理器，指出其採用更新的核心架構，目標是在控制成本的同時，維持日常操作所需的流暢度。影片提到，搭載 Core 3 150U 的機型在 Cinebench R23 單核心測試中得到 192 分；Xe2 內顯則支援 XeSS AI 升頻與 4 倍畫格生成。作者以《電馭叛客 2077》示範，在 1080p 低畫質並開啟相關功能後，平均可達約 90 FPS，展現入門文書筆電也能應付部分遊戲的可能性。

金屬機身、連接埠與攜帶性

作者認為 Vivobook S 16 的設計以實用為主，機身 A、C、D 面採用金屬材質，結構扎實，霧面外觀也適合辦公、拜訪客戶或課堂簡報；此外還通過 MIL-STD-810H 軍規測試。連接埠包括 HDMI 2.1 TMDS、兩組支援 PD 充電與影像輸出的 USB-C、兩組 USB-A，以及 3.5 mm 耳機孔。實測筆電約重 1.6 公斤，搭配 45W 變壓器約 1.83 公斤，也可使用相容的 PD 充電器。螢幕可平躺至 180 度，偏好較小尺寸的使用者則可考慮約 1.2 公斤的 Vivobook S14。

適合文書工作的螢幕

這款筆電採用 16 吋、16:10 比例的 FHD+ IPS 螢幕，並支援最高 120Hz 更新率及 30Hz 至 120Hz VRR，可增加文件閱讀與多視窗工作的垂直空間。作者實測螢幕涵蓋 99.9% sRGB 與 83.6% DCI-P3，亮度最高約 330 尼特，足以應付一般室內環境；色彩表現則以日常辦公和影音娛樂為主，若要進行 sRGB 照片編輯，建議另行校色。螢幕也具備低藍光與不閃屏相關認證，並配有 1080p 網路攝影機，但不支援臉部辨識。

鍵盤、觸控板與操作便利性

鍵盤配置包含獨立數字鍵區與完整尺寸方向鍵，方便輸入資料；鍵帽採霧面抗指紋處理，並設有麥克風靜音、關閉鏡頭、截圖等快捷鍵。透過 ScreenExpert 按鍵，使用者也能快速叫出風扇、電池及顯示模式的螢幕快捷選項。觸控板面積寬大，滑動操作正常，但實體按壓需按在左下或右下角；鍵盤手感偏薄、稍軟，作者認為適合長時間打字。

處理器測試與效能定位

拆機與跑分段落中，作者介紹測試機搭載 Intel Core 7 150U，配置為 2 個效能核心與 4 個低功耗核心，共 6 核心、8 執行緒及 12MB 快取。Cinebench R23 單核心成績為 1,992 分，作者表示表現大致接近相近功耗下的 Core Ultra 7 155H，並比前一代 Core Ultra 7 155U 高約 4.9%；多核心效能則約為 Core Ultra 7 155U 的八成。整體而言，作者認為這類處理器足以應付報告撰寫、影音播放等日常工作，後續也將繼續檢視其實際效能。

================================================

As a veteran gamer, you must have heard. the saying: "If you don't buy and I. don't buy, the price will drop by 500. tomorrow." But in the 2026 era of. rising memory and SSD prices, this no. longer holds true. It has become: "Even. if you don't buy and I don't buy, it'll. still be 500 higher tomorrow." I can. only congratulate those who took advice. and bought their PCs late last year; you probably sleep soundly at night. Welcome back, I'm Donkey. This year,. anything related to electronics is. rising in price. Just think, what was I. doing this time in previous years? I. would have been doing high-value topics. like "buy an OLED monitor, get a laptop. free." But it's not that I don't want. to do that this year, I really can't. I. have to hold off for now and keep. observing. However, I know the demand. for computers won't disappear,. especially with the September. back-to-school season, where many. brands are offering new machine. discounts. I bought one a while ago,. but there weren't any discounts at all! Those daily promotional events are. really gone, so students should still. seize the opportunities in this wave. So, I've prepared two new laptops this. year to review: the ASUS Vivobook S 16,. a 16-inch office laptop around 40,000. NTD that I think has a great chassis. and is quite practical. I also prepared. an entry-level document laptop around. 20,000 NTD, representing the Vivobook. 14 from ASUS. Today, we will primarily. focus our testing on the Vivobook S 16. Both of these machines are equipped. with the new Intel Core Series 3. processors, built for. entry-to-mid-level document laptops. Although they are entry-level. processors, the key highlight is their. new architecture, providing the. fluidity expected in 2026 while scaling. down the core count to control costs. For instance, if we run Cinebench R23,. we can see the Vivobook S 16 with the. Intel Core 3 150U scores 192 points in. single-core, which is basically. identical to the previous generation's. Core Ultra 7 155H. It even performs. slightly better than the Core Ultra 7. 258V. So, Intel's brand new entry-level. series guarantees a solid daily. experience. For tasks like web browsing. and writing reports—which mainly rely. on single-core performance—you can. achieve a smooth experience that. performs quite well. But the coolest. part is that Intel actually used the. latest Xe2 GPU architecture for the. integrated graphics in these. entry-level processors. So, even with. the Core 3 150 U's Xe2 GPU, the.

Vivobook S 16 can support the latest. XeSS AI upscaling and even 4x frame. generation. And what does that actually. mean? It means that even on an. entry-level document laptop like this,. you can actually play Cyberpunk 2077. For instance, if we open 2077, at 1080p. low settings, with XCeSS and 4x frame. generation enabled, we actually get an. average of 90fps, which is perfectly. smooth. This is even more surreal than. Cyberpunk itself; it's truly hard to. believe—what on earth happened in. 2026? Anyway, life goes on regardless. of the technical specs, so what kind of. performance can we really expect from a. 2026 productivity laptop? Let’s take. a look together. Let’s start by. looking at the exterior. The Vivobook. S16 we're unboxing today is, in my. opinion, a machine that is entirely. focused on practicality. First off,. even though this is a 16-inch. entry-level model, ASUS hasn't. compromised on the build materials. Except for the screen bezel (B-side),. the A, C, and D sides are all made of. metal, and because the metal is quite. thick, even pressing hard on the. surface, the overall structural. integrity is well above average. What’s more special is the refined. matte finish on the metal surfaces,. combined with a minimalist design,. making it perfect for working at cafes,. meeting clients, or giving class. presentations. Crucially, it also. passed the MIL-STD-810H military-grade. tests, including shock, vibration, high. temperature, and low temperature. On. top of that, it comes with plenty of I/. O ports. Starting on the left, ASUS. included an HDMI 2.1 TMDS port, capable. of 4K 60Hz output, along with two USB. 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C ports. These two ports. not only support PD charging but also. handle video output, so they can be. used for external displays. Finally,. there is a 3.5 mm audio jack. Moving to. the right side, there are two more USB. 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A ports. Overall, with. two Type-A, two Type-C, an HDMI, and an. audio jack, plus the fact that both C. ports support charging and video output. , it’s a big plus. Having the Type-A. ports on the right is convenient for. mouse or keyboard receivers—. everything you need is there. As for. the weight, our testing shows the. Vivobook S16 itself weighs 1.6 kg, and. with the official 45W charger, it comes. to 1.83 kg total. For a 16-inch. full-metal laptop, the weight is still. relatively comfortable. Of course, if. you want to travel lighter, you can use. your own single-port PD charger. Since. it only requires 45W at most, it's.

compatible with common 65W or 100W. phone chargers. The lid can usually be. opened with one hand. It can also lay. flat at 180 degrees. Also, for those. who prefer a 14-inch model, the same. series includes a 14-inch, 1.2 kg. Vivobook S14 as an option. Now, let’s. look at the B-side. The Vivobook S16. also features the currently mainstream. 16:10 aspect ratio screen. For one, it. provides a larger vertical display area. when handling documents. For instance,. having Word open on one side and Excel. on the other. Or two-thirds for. PowerPoint and one-third for Chrome. No. matter how you split it, both sides. have more vertical display space,. allowing for better document reading. You can even use it for basic Photoshop. editing or Premiere video cutting,. where the timeline can fit an extra row. . Meanwhile, the 16:10 screen looks. more immersive with a three-sided. narrow bezel design that is both. stylish and functional. In terms of. screen specifications, the Vivobook S16. is equipped with a 16-inch FHD + IPS. panel and achieves a high refresh rate. of up to 120Hz. Crucially, it also. supports a 30Hz to 120Hz VRR variable. refresh rate, with a rated peak. brightness of 300 nits. Furthermore,. this unit has received TÜV Rheinland. certification for low blue light and. flicker-free performance. Now, let's. move on to our channel's testing. segment. First, based on our tests, the. Vivobook S16 achieves 99.9%sRGB and. 83.6%DCI-P 3 color gamut coverage. It. is basically a standard sRGB screen. Regarding color accuracy, this unit. does not have a built-in profile. In. standard mode, our initial measurement. for CCT fell at 7172K. Since it's tuned. to be easy on the eyes, there was no. need to measure further. It is. perfectly fine for daily office work. and media consumption, but if you have. photo editing needs within sRGB, you. will need to calibrate it separately. As for brightness, our tests show that. at 100%SDR display, it can reach 330. nits, hitting the officially rated 300-. nit level, which is sufficient for. typical well-lit office environments. Finally, the Vivobook S16 features a. 1080p webcam at the top of the B-side. However, it does not support facial. recognition. Moving on to the C-side,. the keyboard and touchpad offer some. surprises. First, ASUS not only. provided a dedicated number pad, which. is great for document work, but also. included full-size arrow keys, which. was an unexpected nice touch. That is. why I say this is a very practical. laptop. Additionally, ASUS has applied.

a matte, anti-fingerprint coating to. every key. Besides being less prone to. sweat stains, it also helps extend the. lifespan of the keycaps for long-term. typing. Furthermore, the Vivobook S16. has a row of useful hotkeys at the top,. including one-touch microphone mute,. one-touch camera disable, one-touch. screenshot, and more. And with the. ScreenExpert button, you can pull up. virtual shortcuts on the screen to. quickly adjust fan, battery, and. display modes. Additionally, regarding. the trackpad, ASUS has generously. included a very, very large surface. area for this model. It works well for. navigation, though the smoothness is. standard, and you'll need to press. toward the bottom left or right corners. for physical clicks, so keep that in. mind. But if you’re used to tapping. on the trackpad, then it won't be an. issue. As for the keyboard feel, it’s. thin and slightly soft, which is fine. for long typing sessions. Here is a. sample of the key sounds for you. Alright, with the design covered, let's. move straight to the performance tests. you’re all interested in. But before. that, let's open up the Vivobook S 16. to see the hardware components inside. First, let's look at the CPU; most new. entry-level office laptops are equipped. with the latest Intel Core Series 1. processors. The coolest thing about. this new series is that it uses the. same CPU core architecture as the. flagship Intel Core Ultra Series 1. processors. For example, the Vivobook S. 16 we're unboxing features the Intel. Core 7 150U processor, with two. high-performance P-cores, no E-cores,. but four upgraded LP E-cores for. low-load tasks, totaling 6 cores and 8. threads with 12MB of cache. Without. further ado, let's run Cinebench R23. The Intel Core 7 150U in the Vivobook S. 16 scored 1,992 in single-core. This is. basically identical to the performance. of the Core Ultra 7 155H at similar. power levels. Compared to the previous. generation Core Ultra 7 155U processor,. it offers a 4.9%performance lead. So,. for tasks like writing reports,. watching videos, or using Photoshop. where single-core performance matters,. the user experience is guaranteed. As. for multi-core, since it lacks the. E-cores, the theoretical performance is. about 80%of the Core Ultra 7 155U as. mentioned before. Besides the. interesting CPU, the integrated. graphics also use the latest Intel Arc. architecture. While it has four. Xe-cores, it supports new-gen features. like XeSS and frame generation. According to our tests, the theoretical.

performance in 3DMark Time Spy reaches. about 1,715 points. But thanks to XeSS. and frame generation, we can actually. test a demanding AAA title like. Cyberpunk 2077 on this entry-level. laptop. Starting at 1080p Low settings,. we enable XCSS and 4x frame generation,. which delivers a playable average of 99. FPS. We even tested the more demanding. Black Myth: Wukong, also at 1080p Low,. and with XCSS and 4x frame generation,. it reached an average of 57 FPS. Don't. forget, this is just a dual-core chip; I’m absolutely losing my mind! Testing games on a budget laptop and. getting smooth performance—you. wouldn't have dared to imagine this two. years ago. It’s truly the magic of. 2026. Intel has been quite generous,. using their latest Intel 18A process. for both the CPU and GPU. In short, if. you see a CPU this year where the ' Ultra' label is missing and the model. number starts with a 3, like these. I’ve listed: Intel Core 3 304, Core 5. 320, or Core 7 350. The middle number (. 3, 5, 7)—the higher it is, the higher. the tier and the stronger the. performance. As for the model number,. if the first digit is a 3, it’s the. latest Intel Core series, like the 304,. 320, or 350; again, higher numbers mean. better performance. Intel has also. included an NPU in this series for AI. tasks, delivering up to 17 TOPS of AI. compute, with the GPU adding another 21. TOPS. This makes it very capable for. daily tasks, like running offline AI. tools. For example, when video. conferencing, we can turn on Windows. Studio Effects like auto-framing, which. tracks your movement. Turn on eye. contact and background blur, and. you’ll see the NPU kick into gear. It. handles these persistent AI tasks. efficiently, bringing AIPC capabilities. to more affordable devices. By the way,. if you’ve picked up a Vivobook. recently, it comes with three months of. Google AI Premium—don't forget to. claim it! Overall, while these are. entry-level processors, they capture. the essence of the series and maintain. a solid daily experience. On the other. hand, to keep costs down, some. trade-offs were made, like removing the. E2 cache and dual-channel support,. specifically tailored for the. entry-level market. But in terms of. results, they have certainly achieved. better cost control. Take this Vivobook. 14 I have here, priced around 20,000; it’s equipped with a Core 5 320. processor. And believe it or not, this. sub-20,000 laptop can even run. Cyberpunk 2077, managing an average of. 52 FPS. Regarding the internal design,.

you can see from the screen that the. whole series is quite compact due to. the minimal cooling requirements. The. motherboard is tiny, and because the. power draw is low, the total system TDP. sits at just 30 watts. So, you can see. that ASUS uses a heat pipe and a fin. stack in the Vivobook S 16. Coupled. with a cooling fan design, it’s more. than enough to handle the Intel Core. Ultra 7 155H. Interestingly, ASUS also. included an internal airflow channel. design here. You can see a small. opening on the right side of the fan,. which allows it to direct some airflow. onto the motherboard to help manage. internal heat. On the bottom cover,. you’ll also find a thick thermal pad. It aligns with the motherboard’s SSD,. so the SSD's heat is conducted to the. metal bottom cover for cooling. Speaking of the SSD, our Vivobook S 16. is equipped with a 512GB SanDisk PCIe. 4.0 SSD. We tested it with sequential. read speeds of 4103 MB/s and write. speeds of 2354 MB/s. As for the memory,. it’s a single-channel 16GB LPDDR5X. 7467 onboard configuration. Regarding. connectivity, we tested it with the. Realtek Wi-Fi 6 network card, which. connects successfully to Wi-Fi 6. networks and supports Bluetooth 5.4. In. terms of thermals, the Vivobook S 16. achieved a stability score of 99.4%in. the 3DMark Time Spy stress test, with a. peak temperature of 39.2 ° C. The. keyboard area remained cool, reaching. only about 33.7 ° C, and the fan was. barely audible, peaking at just 41. decibels—very quiet. When it comes to. battery life, this is where Intel Core. Ultra processors differ most from. previous generations, and they really. can't be compared. With the 75Wh. battery inside the Vivobook S 16, it. still managed 11 hours and 49 minutes. in the PCMark battery test, which is. plenty for daily use. If you're going. out for long periods, it's recommended. to carry a PD charger or a power bank. for extra peace of mind. For charging,. ASUS includes a 90W USB-C charger. Our. tests show it hits 26%in half an hour,. 51%in an hour, and a full charge takes. 2 hours and 21 minutes. As for audio,. it features a dual-speaker design. We. measured a maximum volume of around 81. decibels; we've provided the test. sample at the end for your reference. Overall, this year's Vivobook S 16 is a. practical, no-nonsense choice,. featuring an all-metal chassis,. sufficient and complete ports, a. dedicated numeric keypad, full-sized. arrow keys, a mineral-coated finish,. and a large trackpad. It also manages. 30W TDP, has an internal airflow.

channel, includes a thermal pad for the. SSD, and boasts a 16:10 display ratio. with a 144Hz refresh rate, making daily. office tasks and scrolling much. smoother. It’s an office laptop that. puts the entire budget into user. experience. To some extent, the Intel. Core Series 3 processors have indeed. helped with cost control amidst these. turbulent times, and by relying on the. same core architecture as the deeper. processors, they at least guarantee a. certain level of daily fluency. With. XESS and 4x frame generation, you can. even touch some 3A titles; these are. things we never dared to imagine before. , and they use their own latest Intel. 18A process technology. Calculating it. all, this Vbook 14, which costs around. 20,000, finally gets to use an Intel. Core 5 120U with a similar scale. As. for advice on purchasing office laptops. , I want to be clear: if you are. looking for new models released in 2026. , with memory prices soaring, brands. generally only have two choices: either. maintain specifications and follow the. price hike, or compromise on specs to. keep the price around the same level. If you want to find new models, there. are only two paths to choose from. This. is the reality of the current market; there is really no other way. That is. why I say, if you see a good option,. grab it quickly, and prioritize. practical specs like those on the. Vivobook 16 to at least maintain the. expected experience. Then there is the. 16-inch all-metal chassis with all the. essential specs, and the price of. around 40,000 is still relatively. manageable. Nobody knows if this is the. worst of it, so evaluate carefully. yourself, but at least those who bought. a laptop half a year ago should be. watching this show with a satisfied. smile. As we expected, following the. continued rise in memory prices,. peripheral specs took the first hit. For instance, OLED displays have almost. vanished from entry-level models, and. our popular "buy an OLED screen, get a. laptop" promotion has to be painfully. paused for now. Finally, I will provide. you with all the benchmark tests as. usual. Alright, that's enough for now. In this episode, we’ve probably. covered the most data and hands-on. experience possible. If you still have. any questions, If you enjoyed this. episode, don't forget to subscribe to. our channel and turn on the. notification bell so you can receive. alerts for our latest reviews. immediately. Of course, you can also. find us on Facebook, Instagram, and. LINE. If you have any other questions,.

don't forget to leave a comment below. See you!

item.description:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QhKhGuCjcYM

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解記憶體與 SSD 漲價潮下，2026 年筆電市場及開學季促銷的現況。
  • 從機身、螢幕、鍵盤到連接埠，掌握 ASUS Vivobook S 16 作為文書筆電的實用設計與取捨。
  • 看看新一代 Intel 入門處理器與 Xe2 內顯的表現，以及影片展示的遊戲與跑分結果。

摘要

漲價環境下的筆電選擇

作者表示，2026 年記憶體、SSD 等電子零組件價格持續上漲，過去「不買就會降價」的說法似乎已不再適用。他認為電腦需求仍然存在，尤其開學季仍有品牌推出優惠，因此準備介紹兩款 ASUS 筆電：一款約新台幣四萬元的 16 吋 Vivobook S 16，以及約兩萬元的 14 吋入門文書機。本次評測主要聚焦在 Vivobook S 16。

新處理器與入門遊戲能力

作者介紹新一代 Intel Core 系列處理器，指出其採用更新的核心架構，目標是在控制成本的同時，維持日常操作所需的流暢度。影片提到，搭載 Core 3 150U 的機型在 Cinebench R23 單核心測試中得到 192 分；Xe2 內顯則支援 XeSS AI 升頻與 4 倍畫格生成。作者以《電馭叛客 2077》示範，在 1080p 低畫質並開啟相關功能後，平均可達約 90 FPS，展現入門文書筆電也能應付部分遊戲的可能性。

金屬機身、連接埠與攜帶性

作者認為 Vivobook S 16 的設計以實用為主，機身 A、C、D 面採用金屬材質，結構扎實，霧面外觀也適合辦公、拜訪客戶或課堂簡報；此外還通過 MIL-STD-810H 軍規測試。連接埠包括 HDMI 2.1 TMDS、兩組支援 PD 充電與影像輸出的 USB-C、兩組 USB-A，以及 3.5 mm 耳機孔。實測筆電約重 1.6 公斤，搭配 45W 變壓器約 1.83 公斤，也可使用相容的 PD 充電器。螢幕可平躺至 180 度，偏好較小尺寸的使用者則可考慮約 1.2 公斤的 Vivobook S14。

適合文書工作的螢幕

這款筆電採用 16 吋、16:10 比例的 FHD+ IPS 螢幕，並支援最高 120Hz 更新率及 30Hz 至 120Hz VRR，可增加文件閱讀與多視窗工作的垂直空間。作者實測螢幕涵蓋 99.9% sRGB 與 83.6% DCI-P3，亮度最高約 330 尼特，足以應付一般室內環境；色彩表現則以日常辦公和影音娛樂為主，若要進行 sRGB 照片編輯，建議另行校色。螢幕也具備低藍光與不閃屏相關認證，並配有 1080p 網路攝影機，但不支援臉部辨識。

鍵盤、觸控板與操作便利性

鍵盤配置包含獨立數字鍵區與完整尺寸方向鍵，方便輸入資料；鍵帽採霧面抗指紋處理，並設有麥克風靜音、關閉鏡頭、截圖等快捷鍵。透過 ScreenExpert 按鍵，使用者也能快速叫出風扇、電池及顯示模式的螢幕快捷選項。觸控板面積寬大，滑動操作正常，但實體按壓需按在左下或右下角；鍵盤手感偏薄、稍軟，作者認為適合長時間打字。

處理器測試與效能定位

拆機與跑分段落中，作者介紹測試機搭載 Intel Core 7 150U，配置為 2 個效能核心與 4 個低功耗核心，共 6 核心、8 執行緒及 12MB 快取。Cinebench R23 單核心成績為 1,992 分，作者表示表現大致接近相近功耗下的 Core Ultra 7 155H，並比前一代 Core Ultra 7 155U 高約 4.9%；多核心效能則約為 Core Ultra 7 155U 的八成。整體而言，作者認為這類處理器足以應付報告撰寫、影音播放等日常工作，後續也將繼續檢視其實際效能。

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解記憶體與 SSD 漲價潮下，2026 年筆電市場及開學季促銷的現況。
  • 從機身、螢幕、鍵盤到連接埠，掌握 ASUS Vivobook S 16 作為文書筆電的實用設計與取捨。
  • 看看新一代 Intel 入門處理器與 Xe2 內顯的表現，以及影片展示的遊戲與跑分結果。

摘要

漲價環境下的筆電選擇

作者表示，2026 年記憶體、SSD 等電子零組件價格持續上漲，過去「不買就會降價」的說法似乎已不再適用。他認為電腦需求仍然存在，尤其開學季仍有品牌推出優惠，因此準備介紹兩款 ASUS 筆電：一款約新台幣四萬元的 16 吋 Vivobook S 16，以及約兩萬元的 14 吋入門文書機。本次評測主要聚焦在 Vivobook S 16。

新處理器與入門遊戲能力

作者介紹新一代 Intel Core 系列處理器，指出其採用更新的核心架構，目標是在控制成本的同時，維持日常操作所需的流暢度。影片提到，搭載 Core 3 150U 的機型在 Cinebench R23 單核心測試中得到 192 分；Xe2 內顯則支援 XeSS AI 升頻與 4 倍畫格生成。作者以《電馭叛客 2077》示範，在 1080p 低畫質並開啟相關功能後，平均可達約 90 FPS，展現入門文書筆電也能應付部分遊戲的可能性。

金屬機身、連接埠與攜帶性

作者認為 Vivobook S 16 的設計以實用為主，機身 A、C、D 面採用金屬材質，結構扎實，霧面外觀也適合辦公、拜訪客戶或課堂簡報；此外還通過 MIL-STD-810H 軍規測試。連接埠包括 HDMI 2.1 TMDS、兩組支援 PD 充電與影像輸出的 USB-C、兩組 USB-A，以及 3.5 mm 耳機孔。實測筆電約重 1.6 公斤，搭配 45W 變壓器約 1.83 公斤，也可使用相容的 PD 充電器。螢幕可平躺至 180 度，偏好較小尺寸的使用者則可考慮約 1.2 公斤的 Vivobook S14。

適合文書工作的螢幕

這款筆電採用 16 吋、16:10 比例的 FHD+ IPS 螢幕，並支援最高 120Hz 更新率及 30Hz 至 120Hz VRR，可增加文件閱讀與多視窗工作的垂直空間。作者實測螢幕涵蓋 99.9% sRGB 與 83.6% DCI-P3，亮度最高約 330 尼特，足以應付一般室內環境；色彩表現則以日常辦公和影音娛樂為主，若要進行 sRGB 照片編輯，建議另行校色。螢幕也具備低藍光與不閃屏相關認證，並配有 1080p 網路攝影機，但不支援臉部辨識。

鍵盤、觸控板與操作便利性

鍵盤配置包含獨立數字鍵區與完整尺寸方向鍵，方便輸入資料；鍵帽採霧面抗指紋處理，並設有麥克風靜音、關閉鏡頭、截圖等快捷鍵。透過 ScreenExpert 按鍵，使用者也能快速叫出風扇、電池及顯示模式的螢幕快捷選項。觸控板面積寬大，滑動操作正常，但實體按壓需按在左下或右下角；鍵盤手感偏薄、稍軟，作者認為適合長時間打字。

處理器測試與效能定位

拆機與跑分段落中，作者介紹測試機搭載 Intel Core 7 150U，配置為 2 個效能核心與 4 個低功耗核心，共 6 核心、8 執行緒及 12MB 快取。Cinebench R23 單核心成績為 1,992 分，作者表示表現大致接近相近功耗下的 Core Ultra 7 155H，並比前一代 Core Ultra 7 155U 高約 4.9%；多核心效能則約為 Core Ultra 7 155U 的八成。整體而言，作者認為這類處理器足以應付報告撰寫、影音播放等日常工作，後續也將繼續檢視其實際效能。

================================================

As a veteran gamer, you must have heard. the saying: "If you don't buy and I. don't buy, the price will drop by 500. tomorrow." But in the 2026 era of. rising memory and SSD prices, this no. longer holds true. It has become: "Even. if you don't buy and I don't buy, it'll. still be 500 higher tomorrow." I can. only congratulate those who took advice. and bought their PCs late last year; you probably sleep soundly at night. Welcome back, I'm Donkey. This year,. anything related to electronics is. rising in price. Just think, what was I. doing this time in previous years? I. would have been doing high-value topics. like "buy an OLED monitor, get a laptop. free." But it's not that I don't want. to do that this year, I really can't. I. have to hold off for now and keep. observing. However, I know the demand. for computers won't disappear,. especially with the September. back-to-school season, where many. brands are offering new machine. discounts. I bought one a while ago,. but there weren't any discounts at all! Those daily promotional events are. really gone, so students should still. seize the opportunities in this wave. So, I've prepared two new laptops this. year to review: the ASUS Vivobook S 16,. a 16-inch office laptop around 40,000. NTD that I think has a great chassis. and is quite practical. I also prepared. an entry-level document laptop around. 20,000 NTD, representing the Vivobook. 14 from ASUS. Today, we will primarily. focus our testing on the Vivobook S 16. Both of these machines are equipped. with the new Intel Core Series 3. processors, built for. entry-to-mid-level document laptops. Although they are entry-level. processors, the key highlight is their. new architecture, providing the. fluidity expected in 2026 while scaling. down the core count to control costs. For instance, if we run Cinebench R23,. we can see the Vivobook S 16 with the. Intel Core 3 150U scores 192 points in. single-core, which is basically. identical to the previous generation's. Core Ultra 7 155H. It even performs. slightly better than the Core Ultra 7. 258V. So, Intel's brand new entry-level. series guarantees a solid daily. experience. For tasks like web browsing. and writing reports—which mainly rely. on single-core performance—you can. achieve a smooth experience that. performs quite well. But the coolest. part is that Intel actually used the. latest Xe2 GPU architecture for the. integrated graphics in these. entry-level processors. So, even with. the Core 3 150 U's Xe2 GPU, the.

Vivobook S 16 can support the latest. XeSS AI upscaling and even 4x frame. generation. And what does that actually. mean? It means that even on an. entry-level document laptop like this,. you can actually play Cyberpunk 2077. For instance, if we open 2077, at 1080p. low settings, with XCeSS and 4x frame. generation enabled, we actually get an. average of 90fps, which is perfectly. smooth. This is even more surreal than. Cyberpunk itself; it's truly hard to. believe—what on earth happened in. 2026? Anyway, life goes on regardless. of the technical specs, so what kind of. performance can we really expect from a. 2026 productivity laptop? Let’s take. a look together. Let’s start by. looking at the exterior. The Vivobook. S16 we're unboxing today is, in my. opinion, a machine that is entirely. focused on practicality. First off,. even though this is a 16-inch. entry-level model, ASUS hasn't. compromised on the build materials. Except for the screen bezel (B-side),. the A, C, and D sides are all made of. metal, and because the metal is quite. thick, even pressing hard on the. surface, the overall structural. integrity is well above average. What’s more special is the refined. matte finish on the metal surfaces,. combined with a minimalist design,. making it perfect for working at cafes,. meeting clients, or giving class. presentations. Crucially, it also. passed the MIL-STD-810H military-grade. tests, including shock, vibration, high. temperature, and low temperature. On. top of that, it comes with plenty of I/. O ports. Starting on the left, ASUS. included an HDMI 2.1 TMDS port, capable. of 4K 60Hz output, along with two USB. 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C ports. These two ports. not only support PD charging but also. handle video output, so they can be. used for external displays. Finally,. there is a 3.5 mm audio jack. Moving to. the right side, there are two more USB. 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A ports. Overall, with. two Type-A, two Type-C, an HDMI, and an. audio jack, plus the fact that both C. ports support charging and video output. , it’s a big plus. Having the Type-A. ports on the right is convenient for. mouse or keyboard receivers—. everything you need is there. As for. the weight, our testing shows the. Vivobook S16 itself weighs 1.6 kg, and. with the official 45W charger, it comes. to 1.83 kg total. For a 16-inch. full-metal laptop, the weight is still. relatively comfortable. Of course, if. you want to travel lighter, you can use. your own single-port PD charger. Since. it only requires 45W at most, it's.

compatible with common 65W or 100W. phone chargers. The lid can usually be. opened with one hand. It can also lay. flat at 180 degrees. Also, for those. who prefer a 14-inch model, the same. series includes a 14-inch, 1.2 kg. Vivobook S14 as an option. Now, let’s. look at the B-side. The Vivobook S16. also features the currently mainstream. 16:10 aspect ratio screen. For one, it. provides a larger vertical display area. when handling documents. For instance,. having Word open on one side and Excel. on the other. Or two-thirds for. PowerPoint and one-third for Chrome. No. matter how you split it, both sides. have more vertical display space,. allowing for better document reading. You can even use it for basic Photoshop. editing or Premiere video cutting,. where the timeline can fit an extra row. . Meanwhile, the 16:10 screen looks. more immersive with a three-sided. narrow bezel design that is both. stylish and functional. In terms of. screen specifications, the Vivobook S16. is equipped with a 16-inch FHD + IPS. panel and achieves a high refresh rate. of up to 120Hz. Crucially, it also. supports a 30Hz to 120Hz VRR variable. refresh rate, with a rated peak. brightness of 300 nits. Furthermore,. this unit has received TÜV Rheinland. certification for low blue light and. flicker-free performance. Now, let's. move on to our channel's testing. segment. First, based on our tests, the. Vivobook S16 achieves 99.9%sRGB and. 83.6%DCI-P 3 color gamut coverage. It. is basically a standard sRGB screen. Regarding color accuracy, this unit. does not have a built-in profile. In. standard mode, our initial measurement. for CCT fell at 7172K. Since it's tuned. to be easy on the eyes, there was no. need to measure further. It is. perfectly fine for daily office work. and media consumption, but if you have. photo editing needs within sRGB, you. will need to calibrate it separately. As for brightness, our tests show that. at 100%SDR display, it can reach 330. nits, hitting the officially rated 300-. nit level, which is sufficient for. typical well-lit office environments. Finally, the Vivobook S16 features a. 1080p webcam at the top of the B-side. However, it does not support facial. recognition. Moving on to the C-side,. the keyboard and touchpad offer some. surprises. First, ASUS not only. provided a dedicated number pad, which. is great for document work, but also. included full-size arrow keys, which. was an unexpected nice touch. That is. why I say this is a very practical. laptop. Additionally, ASUS has applied.

a matte, anti-fingerprint coating to. every key. Besides being less prone to. sweat stains, it also helps extend the. lifespan of the keycaps for long-term. typing. Furthermore, the Vivobook S16. has a row of useful hotkeys at the top,. including one-touch microphone mute,. one-touch camera disable, one-touch. screenshot, and more. And with the. ScreenExpert button, you can pull up. virtual shortcuts on the screen to. quickly adjust fan, battery, and. display modes. Additionally, regarding. the trackpad, ASUS has generously. included a very, very large surface. area for this model. It works well for. navigation, though the smoothness is. standard, and you'll need to press. toward the bottom left or right corners. for physical clicks, so keep that in. mind. But if you’re used to tapping. on the trackpad, then it won't be an. issue. As for the keyboard feel, it’s. thin and slightly soft, which is fine. for long typing sessions. Here is a. sample of the key sounds for you. Alright, with the design covered, let's. move straight to the performance tests. you’re all interested in. But before. that, let's open up the Vivobook S 16. to see the hardware components inside. First, let's look at the CPU; most new. entry-level office laptops are equipped. with the latest Intel Core Series 1. processors. The coolest thing about. this new series is that it uses the. same CPU core architecture as the. flagship Intel Core Ultra Series 1. processors. For example, the Vivobook S. 16 we're unboxing features the Intel. Core 7 150U processor, with two. high-performance P-cores, no E-cores,. but four upgraded LP E-cores for. low-load tasks, totaling 6 cores and 8. threads with 12MB of cache. Without. further ado, let's run Cinebench R23. The Intel Core 7 150U in the Vivobook S. 16 scored 1,992 in single-core. This is. basically identical to the performance. of the Core Ultra 7 155H at similar. power levels. Compared to the previous. generation Core Ultra 7 155U processor,. it offers a 4.9%performance lead. So,. for tasks like writing reports,. watching videos, or using Photoshop. where single-core performance matters,. the user experience is guaranteed. As. for multi-core, since it lacks the. E-cores, the theoretical performance is. about 80%of the Core Ultra 7 155U as. mentioned before. Besides the. interesting CPU, the integrated. graphics also use the latest Intel Arc. architecture. While it has four. Xe-cores, it supports new-gen features. like XeSS and frame generation. According to our tests, the theoretical.

performance in 3DMark Time Spy reaches. about 1,715 points. But thanks to XeSS. and frame generation, we can actually. test a demanding AAA title like. Cyberpunk 2077 on this entry-level. laptop. Starting at 1080p Low settings,. we enable XCSS and 4x frame generation,. which delivers a playable average of 99. FPS. We even tested the more demanding. Black Myth: Wukong, also at 1080p Low,. and with XCSS and 4x frame generation,. it reached an average of 57 FPS. Don't. forget, this is just a dual-core chip; I’m absolutely losing my mind! Testing games on a budget laptop and. getting smooth performance—you. wouldn't have dared to imagine this two. years ago. It’s truly the magic of. 2026. Intel has been quite generous,. using their latest Intel 18A process. for both the CPU and GPU. In short, if. you see a CPU this year where the ' Ultra' label is missing and the model. number starts with a 3, like these. I’ve listed: Intel Core 3 304, Core 5. 320, or Core 7 350. The middle number (. 3, 5, 7)—the higher it is, the higher. the tier and the stronger the. performance. As for the model number,. if the first digit is a 3, it’s the. latest Intel Core series, like the 304,. 320, or 350; again, higher numbers mean. better performance. Intel has also. included an NPU in this series for AI. tasks, delivering up to 17 TOPS of AI. compute, with the GPU adding another 21. TOPS. This makes it very capable for. daily tasks, like running offline AI. tools. For example, when video. conferencing, we can turn on Windows. Studio Effects like auto-framing, which. tracks your movement. Turn on eye. contact and background blur, and. you’ll see the NPU kick into gear. It. handles these persistent AI tasks. efficiently, bringing AIPC capabilities. to more affordable devices. By the way,. if you’ve picked up a Vivobook. recently, it comes with three months of. Google AI Premium—don't forget to. claim it! Overall, while these are. entry-level processors, they capture. the essence of the series and maintain. a solid daily experience. On the other. hand, to keep costs down, some. trade-offs were made, like removing the. E2 cache and dual-channel support,. specifically tailored for the. entry-level market. But in terms of. results, they have certainly achieved. better cost control. Take this Vivobook. 14 I have here, priced around 20,000; it’s equipped with a Core 5 320. processor. And believe it or not, this. sub-20,000 laptop can even run. Cyberpunk 2077, managing an average of. 52 FPS. Regarding the internal design,.

you can see from the screen that the. whole series is quite compact due to. the minimal cooling requirements. The. motherboard is tiny, and because the. power draw is low, the total system TDP. sits at just 30 watts. So, you can see. that ASUS uses a heat pipe and a fin. stack in the Vivobook S 16. Coupled. with a cooling fan design, it’s more. than enough to handle the Intel Core. Ultra 7 155H. Interestingly, ASUS also. included an internal airflow channel. design here. You can see a small. opening on the right side of the fan,. which allows it to direct some airflow. onto the motherboard to help manage. internal heat. On the bottom cover,. you’ll also find a thick thermal pad. It aligns with the motherboard’s SSD,. so the SSD's heat is conducted to the. metal bottom cover for cooling. Speaking of the SSD, our Vivobook S 16. is equipped with a 512GB SanDisk PCIe. 4.0 SSD. We tested it with sequential. read speeds of 4103 MB/s and write. speeds of 2354 MB/s. As for the memory,. it’s a single-channel 16GB LPDDR5X. 7467 onboard configuration. Regarding. connectivity, we tested it with the. Realtek Wi-Fi 6 network card, which. connects successfully to Wi-Fi 6. networks and supports Bluetooth 5.4. In. terms of thermals, the Vivobook S 16. achieved a stability score of 99.4%in. the 3DMark Time Spy stress test, with a. peak temperature of 39.2 ° C. The. keyboard area remained cool, reaching. only about 33.7 ° C, and the fan was. barely audible, peaking at just 41. decibels—very quiet. When it comes to. battery life, this is where Intel Core. Ultra processors differ most from. previous generations, and they really. can't be compared. With the 75Wh. battery inside the Vivobook S 16, it. still managed 11 hours and 49 minutes. in the PCMark battery test, which is. plenty for daily use. If you're going. out for long periods, it's recommended. to carry a PD charger or a power bank. for extra peace of mind. For charging,. ASUS includes a 90W USB-C charger. Our. tests show it hits 26%in half an hour,. 51%in an hour, and a full charge takes. 2 hours and 21 minutes. As for audio,. it features a dual-speaker design. We. measured a maximum volume of around 81. decibels; we've provided the test. sample at the end for your reference. Overall, this year's Vivobook S 16 is a. practical, no-nonsense choice,. featuring an all-metal chassis,. sufficient and complete ports, a. dedicated numeric keypad, full-sized. arrow keys, a mineral-coated finish,. and a large trackpad. It also manages. 30W TDP, has an internal airflow.

channel, includes a thermal pad for the. SSD, and boasts a 16:10 display ratio. with a 144Hz refresh rate, making daily. office tasks and scrolling much. smoother. It’s an office laptop that. puts the entire budget into user. experience. To some extent, the Intel. Core Series 3 processors have indeed. helped with cost control amidst these. turbulent times, and by relying on the. same core architecture as the deeper. processors, they at least guarantee a. certain level of daily fluency. With. XESS and 4x frame generation, you can. even touch some 3A titles; these are. things we never dared to imagine before. , and they use their own latest Intel. 18A process technology. Calculating it. all, this Vbook 14, which costs around. 20,000, finally gets to use an Intel. Core 5 120U with a similar scale. As. for advice on purchasing office laptops. , I want to be clear: if you are. looking for new models released in 2026. , with memory prices soaring, brands. generally only have two choices: either. maintain specifications and follow the. price hike, or compromise on specs to. keep the price around the same level. If you want to find new models, there. are only two paths to choose from. This. is the reality of the current market; there is really no other way. That is. why I say, if you see a good option,. grab it quickly, and prioritize. practical specs like those on the. Vivobook 16 to at least maintain the. expected experience. Then there is the. 16-inch all-metal chassis with all the. essential specs, and the price of. around 40,000 is still relatively. manageable. Nobody knows if this is the. worst of it, so evaluate carefully. yourself, but at least those who bought. a laptop half a year ago should be. watching this show with a satisfied. smile. As we expected, following the. continued rise in memory prices,. peripheral specs took the first hit. For instance, OLED displays have almost. vanished from entry-level models, and. our popular "buy an OLED screen, get a. laptop" promotion has to be painfully. paused for now. Finally, I will provide. you with all the benchmark tests as. usual. Alright, that's enough for now. In this episode, we’ve probably. covered the most data and hands-on. experience possible. If you still have. any questions, If you enjoyed this. episode, don't forget to subscribe to. our channel and turn on the. notification bell so you can receive. alerts for our latest reviews. immediately. Of course, you can also. find us on Facebook, Instagram, and. LINE. If you have any other questions,.

don't forget to leave a comment below. See you!

item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kb4-sHTeCJ0

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解 ECOVACS T90S Pro 如何在維持 19,900 元親民售價的同時，全面下放旗艦級硬體規格。
  • 解析高達 40,000 Pa 的頂級吸力與 32 道加壓水路的滾筒活水洗地技術，看它如何輕鬆應對重油污挑戰。
  • 全面掌握全新「巨浪」高壓底座自清潔、滾筒防護罩與氮化鎵閃充等黑科技，評估是否值得無腦入手。

摘要

加量不加價的性價比黑馬

作者開箱介紹了科沃斯全新推出的 ECOVACS T90S Pro 滾筒掃拖機器人。這款新機延續了上一代 T90 Pro 的熱度，最大的亮點在於「加量不加價」的誠意定價策略，在規格全面升級的情況下，售價依然壓在兩萬元以內、維持 19,900 元，作者認為這將會是下半年市場上極具競爭力的黑馬機種。

頂規吸力與活水滾筒洗地系統

在核心清潔能力方面，作者指出 T90S Pro 將風機模組大幅升級至 40,000 Pa 超大吸力，風量達到每秒 16.45 公升。拖地模組則採用 OZMO Roller 加壓活水洗地技術，透過機身內建的加壓水泵與 16 個出水孔分化出的 32 道加壓水路，搭配每分鐘 260 轉與 3,000 Pa 下壓力，能即時邊拖邊洗滾筒。此外，機身支援 70 度熱水洗地 與沿邊自動伸出滾筒貼邊清潔，滾筒結構更改為快拆設計，清潔維護更加便利。

旗艦級底座自清潔與智慧排污

針對滾筒機種容易產生的異味與污垢問題，T90S Pro 不僅保留了污水盒內部 6,000 轉螺旋槳自清潔設計，更驚喜下放了旗艦專屬的「巨浪」高壓底盤自清潔系統。該系統能透過底座一整排水孔噴出高達 26,000 Pa 的高壓水流，在回洗時直接沖刷底層泥沙塵垢，大幅降低以往底座容易積水發臭、需要頻繁手動刷洗的痛點。

精準避障與智慧清潔策略

在導航與避障表現上，作者展示了 T90S Pro 僅 9.5 公分的超薄機身，能靈活穿梭於低矮家具下。前側配備雙線結構光與 AIVI 3D 4.0 視覺避障模組，並附帶補光燈，即使關燈也能順暢運作。軟體層面具備高度智慧策略，例如遇到大顆粒垃圾時會自動抬升邊刷避免彈飛；偵測到大片污漬時則會主動抬升滾刷與邊刷，僅以滾筒深入拖洗兩次，並立即回洗滾筒以防二次污染，同時還貼心加入寵物友善增壓模式。

全方位的防纏繞、地毯守護與閃充續航

最後，作者翻轉機身檢視底盤結構，T90S Pro 採用側向導流防纏繞主刷與經典風刃邊刷，有效解決毛髮問題。針對地毯清潔，滾筒除了自動抬升 15mm 外，更首度下放滾筒保護罩，在地毯上全面覆蓋滾筒以達成徹底乾濕分離。越障能力支援單階 2.5 公分、雙階 4.9 公分；電力部分則導入軟包動力電池與氮化鎵充電模組的 PowerBoost Plus 閃充技術，回充 3 分鐘即可補充 10% 電量，實現無限續航，搭配集自動集塵、自動補水與自動添加清潔劑的全能基座，將清潔體驗推向新高度。

================================================

Vacuum Discussion Group. Let's start by. looking at the exterior design. The. T90S Pro features a standard circular. body design, using a white and gold. color scheme with a flat top design. The overall look remains simple and. elegant, and the white body is very. easy to fit into any home decor. For. mopping, the T90S Pro has precise water. level adjustments. As always, we. recommend starting from the lowest. setting and increasing it if needed to. avoid water streaks, unless you have. pets, in which case a higher setting is. recommended. This unit also has a. floor-gap cleaning function; we. recommend turning it on for wood floors. to reduce residue in the gaps. Additionally, the new T90S Pro supports. the OK YIKO voice assistant and is a. version that supports ChatGPT, so. besides the programmed commands found. in the app, you can also converse using. natural language. As for smart home. integration, the T90S Pro also features. Matter support and can connect to. Google Home and Siri. Alright, with the. highlights covered, let's jump straight. into our brand-new multi-stage testing. segment. Stage one: Cleaning power test. . We have prepared three common. household cleaning challenges: 10 grams. each of cookie crumbs, sunflower seed. shells, and red beans, for a total of.

30 grams, to test small debris, light. trash, and round, weighted objects. respectively. We can observe the. robot's cleaning efficiency and see if. the side brushes scatter the red beans. Alright, let's start the test. You can. see that under the T90S Pro's smart. cleaning strategy, when it encounters. large piles of debris, it automatically. lifts the side brushes and uses only. suction to avoid scattering them. Test. complete, let's do the final weighing. The T90S Pro started with 30 grams and. recovered 29.73 grams, a recovery rate. of 99.1%, achieving an excellent result. as expected. Stage two: Corner cleaning. test. We used 10 grams of cookie crumbs. , spread evenly along the corner for. the test. Alright, test starts. The. T90S Pro uses its AirBlade side brushes. . According to our measurements, we. recovered 8.95 grams of the original. cookie crumbs, a recovery rate of 89.5%. . Comparing this to our database,. traditional circular models reach about. 60%, while standard retractable side. brushes hit about 80%to 85%; the. AirBlade performs slightly better than. standard retractable brushes. Stage. three, we are testing cleaning speed; we have compiled all the test results. into a table to make them clear at a. glance. Based on our tests, the T90S. Pro can complete the cleaning in about. four and a half minutes, whether the. lights are on or off, reaching a speed. faster than current high-end models,. which take over 5 minutes. Stage four:. Hair entanglement test. For this test,. we are using a batch of long hair, 70. to 80 centimeters in length, spread. across the testing area to simulate a. real-world mess. Alright, test start. Test finished. Let's look at the roller. brush. Ecovacs 'cyclonic anti-tangle. technology is quite mature; basically,. all the hair was successfully separated. with no tangling. It passed. The side. brushes also performed very well, with. no tangling at all. Stage five,. obstacle avoidance. First, let's test. its performance in broad daylight. As. you can see on screen, it successfully. identified risky items on the floor,. including charging cables, extension. cords, and pet waste. A nice detail:. when the T90S Pro passes by high-risk. objects, it even lifts its small "hands. " to minimize the risk. As for the. cylindrical objects, the system. successfully navigated around them to. clean. If you are a more cautious user,. you can still select a more. conservative obstacle avoidance. strategy in the app by enabling. high-sensitivity mode. Stage six, let's. turn off the lights and test it again. For those who like watching infrared. footage, this is a great chance to. observe how the T90S Pro's sensor. module performs. You can see the. advantage of the fill light: even in. the dark, it can still identify and. clear charging cables, extension cords,. and pet waste on the floor. It. successfully navigated around the. cylindrical objects and boldly. approached the dolls, even pushing them. aside to clean, which aligns with. mainstream cleaning strategies. However. , I still want to remind everyone that. before cleaning, it's best to pick up. larger debris from the floor, open. doors when mapping, and clear away. wires and clutter. My conclusion after.

testing so many robots is that no. matter how high-end they are, you still. can't expect them to clean without. tidying up first, so you should still. pick things up. Stage seven, mopping. performance. We're going straight to. the "boss level" test: oyster sauce. In. the app, you can circle the area for. targeted cleaning. This will bring up. the "mop only" option. In this mode,. the robot will automatically lift its. main brush and side brushes, turn off. the vacuum fan, and slowly mop using. only the 27-centimeter roller. As you. can see, tackling the whole patch of. oyster sauce is simple and easy for a. roller-based model. I should remind. everyone that this test is mainly to. verify the roller's effectiveness. If. these situations happen very often at. home, I would still recommend using a. floor washer, as it would be more. practical. Stage eight, noise test. Here is the table. The T90S Pro has. four suction modes. Quiet mode is only. 53 decibels, but for daily use,. standard or the third gear is usually. plenty. I've said it countless times:. for the average home, running it at max. power won't make it much cleaner, but. it will drain the battery quickly. However, if you have carpets, remember. to turn on the carpet boost mode so the. robot automatically switches to max. suction when it steps onto them. Level. nine: battery life. This is basically. Dreame's strongest area right now. To. verify this, we set the suction to the. maximum, selected the densest path for. deep cleaning, set it to clean the. entire space twice, and enabled all. these high-drain settings. In our tests. , under the T90S Pro's "infinite. battery" mode, the AI automatically. schedules fast charging. From the. footage, you can see that every time it. returns to wash the mop, it gains 12%. charge in just a few minutes. Simply. put, "infinite battery" means fast. charging while it's docking, keeping. the charging speed faster than the. power consumption. Looking at our. screen, the T90S Pro's battery level. stayed around 60%to 70%the whole time,. thanks to that fast charging. Ultimately, even with max suction, the. densest path, and two cleaning cycles,. the T90S Pro still maintained a 62%. battery level after a full round. Anyway, this is a traditional strength. of Dreame, remaining one of the devices. you need to worry about the least. regarding battery life. Level ten:. charging test. Since the T90S Pro has. the infinite battery feature, it. essentially won't run out of power, so. we forced it down to 15%to test. Then. we started charging, and our tests show. it fully charges in 1 hour and 57. minutes, still performing as a top-tier. model. Level eleven: roller cleaning. test. We're going straight to the boss. level: we dunked the entire roller into. a mix of soy sauce and thick soy paste. Here is the roller before it was clean,. and here it is after being dirtied. Next, we had the T90S Pro use its 32-. nozzle module to perform a hot water. wash at up to 100 degrees Celsius. The. results are out, just look at the. screen—it's very clear. The roller is. clean enough. Level twelve: dust. collection test. We used 30 grams of. mixed debris plus a handful of pet hair. . Starting the machine. Let's look at.

the results. The T90S Pro's collection. performance is also problem-free. Level. thirteen: carpet test. First, when the. T90S Pro encounters a short-pile carpet. , the rear roller module automatically. lifts by 15mm, and the mop is retracted. to ensure dry-wet separation. It. handles medium-to-long pile carpets the. same way, no problem. The only thing to. note is that for homes with carpets,. remember to enable deep cleaning and. carpet boost. The robot will indeed. automatically increase suction to clean. the carpet more thoroughly. Finally,. level fourteen: obstacle climbing test. Alright, now we're testing a 2.5 cm. door threshold. The T90S Pro handles it. easily, no problem. Next, we'll test a. 4.9 cm double threshold (2.5 + 2.4 cm). It basically handles it, but for those. with higher thresholds, I still. recommend getting a dedicated ramp for. better performance. For the final,. ultimate test, we'll take on the. robot-trap boss: the IKEA stool. Let's. see it in action here. No getting stuck. , it cleared it. Alright, the. performance test is over. Overall, the. strategy for the T90S Pro is exactly. the same as the T90 Pro. ECOVACS has. largely trickled down flagship features. to this model, making it a high-end. roller-mop robot with the most complete. floor mopping features, including a. newly upgraded high-airflow fan. It. features the latest boosted roller, an. upgraded lateral flow anti-tangle. design, upgraded 100-degree hot water. cleaning, and drying functions. It also. includes the popular automatic. detergent dispenser and a slim 9.5 cm. body. The biggest surprise is that. ECOVACS has brought down the "Giant. Wave" chassis self-cleaning system and. the roller cleaning feature that used. to be exclusive to flagships. There’s. also an improved quick-release roller. design. It even includes YIKO GPT. The. key point is that its smart cleaning. strategy is quite comprehensive. For. example, it lifts the side brushes and. increases suction when encountering. debris. When it detects carpets, it. lifts the main brush and side brushes,. and increases suction in pet areas; these flagship specifications make the. T90S Pro highly competitive at this. price point. The robot market today is. truly exciting. Finally, for the. dimensions of the T90S Pro, I’ve. measured them and listed them here for. you, including a 1 cm margin of error. Remember to leave extra space for the. parts that extend beyond the base. station if you are building a cabinet; just use these as a reference. Alright,. the program is coming to an end. item.description:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kb4-sHTeCJ0

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解 ECOVACS T90S Pro 如何在維持 19,900 元親民售價的同時，全面下放旗艦級硬體規格。
  • 解析高達 40,000 Pa 的頂級吸力與 32 道加壓水路的滾筒活水洗地技術，看它如何輕鬆應對重油污挑戰。
  • 全面掌握全新「巨浪」高壓底座自清潔、滾筒防護罩與氮化鎵閃充等黑科技，評估是否值得無腦入手。

摘要

加量不加價的性價比黑馬

作者開箱介紹了科沃斯全新推出的 ECOVACS T90S Pro 滾筒掃拖機器人。這款新機延續了上一代 T90 Pro 的熱度，最大的亮點在於「加量不加價」的誠意定價策略，在規格全面升級的情況下，售價依然壓在兩萬元以內、維持 19,900 元，作者認為這將會是下半年市場上極具競爭力的黑馬機種。

頂規吸力與活水滾筒洗地系統

在核心清潔能力方面，作者指出 T90S Pro 將風機模組大幅升級至 40,000 Pa 超大吸力，風量達到每秒 16.45 公升。拖地模組則採用 OZMO Roller 加壓活水洗地技術，透過機身內建的加壓水泵與 16 個出水孔分化出的 32 道加壓水路，搭配每分鐘 260 轉與 3,000 Pa 下壓力，能即時邊拖邊洗滾筒。此外，機身支援 70 度熱水洗地 與沿邊自動伸出滾筒貼邊清潔，滾筒結構更改為快拆設計，清潔維護更加便利。

旗艦級底座自清潔與智慧排污

針對滾筒機種容易產生的異味與污垢問題，T90S Pro 不僅保留了污水盒內部 6,000 轉螺旋槳自清潔設計，更驚喜下放了旗艦專屬的「巨浪」高壓底盤自清潔系統。該系統能透過底座一整排水孔噴出高達 26,000 Pa 的高壓水流，在回洗時直接沖刷底層泥沙塵垢，大幅降低以往底座容易積水發臭、需要頻繁手動刷洗的痛點。

精準避障與智慧清潔策略

在導航與避障表現上，作者展示了 T90S Pro 僅 9.5 公分的超薄機身，能靈活穿梭於低矮家具下。前側配備雙線結構光與 AIVI 3D 4.0 視覺避障模組，並附帶補光燈，即使關燈也能順暢運作。軟體層面具備高度智慧策略，例如遇到大顆粒垃圾時會自動抬升邊刷避免彈飛；偵測到大片污漬時則會主動抬升滾刷與邊刷，僅以滾筒深入拖洗兩次，並立即回洗滾筒以防二次污染，同時還貼心加入寵物友善增壓模式。

全方位的防纏繞、地毯守護與閃充續航

最後，作者翻轉機身檢視底盤結構，T90S Pro 採用側向導流防纏繞主刷與經典風刃邊刷，有效解決毛髮問題。針對地毯清潔，滾筒除了自動抬升 15mm 外，更首度下放滾筒保護罩，在地毯上全面覆蓋滾筒以達成徹底乾濕分離。越障能力支援單階 2.5 公分、雙階 4.9 公分；電力部分則導入軟包動力電池與氮化鎵充電模組的 PowerBoost Plus 閃充技術，回充 3 分鐘即可補充 10% 電量，實現無限續航，搭配集自動集塵、自動補水與自動添加清潔劑的全能基座，將清潔體驗推向新高度。

================================================

This is a traditional rotary mop robot,. which is completely unable to handle. large areas of dirt. And this is. ECOVACS 'new generation T90S Pro roller. mop robot. The biggest feature of this. roller model is that it cleans the. roller while it mops the floor. So even. in a hellish test of a whole sheet of. thick oil, it faces no pressure at all. That's right, ECOVACS is really going. all out this year. When we unboxed the. new flagship roller T90 Pro, didn't we. boldly predict that an upgraded. high-end T90S Pro was on its way? The. biggest highlight of the T90S Pro this. time is that while the specifications. are fully upgraded, ECOVACS maintains. its sincere tradition of adding. features without increasing the price,. so this generation is priced exactly. the same as the T90 Pro, at just 19,900. . I still strongly support this pricing. strategy. For the past two years,. ECOVACS hasn't played the game of. starting high and slowly raising prices. ; instead, they set a great price right. from the start and don't make. significant increases later, which is. why people feel confident buying it. immediately. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解 ECOVACS T90S Pro 如何在維持 19,900 元親民售價的同時，全面下放旗艦級硬體規格。
  • 解析高達 40,000 Pa 的頂級吸力與 32 道加壓水路的滾筒活水洗地技術，看它如何輕鬆應對重油污挑戰。
  • 全面掌握全新「巨浪」高壓底座自清潔、滾筒防護罩與氮化鎵閃充等黑科技，評估是否值得無腦入手。

摘要

加量不加價的性價比黑馬

作者開箱介紹了科沃斯全新推出的 ECOVACS T90S Pro 滾筒掃拖機器人。這款新機延續了上一代 T90 Pro 的熱度，最大的亮點在於「加量不加價」的誠意定價策略，在規格全面升級的情況下，售價依然壓在兩萬元以內、維持 19,900 元，作者認為這將會是下半年市場上極具競爭力的黑馬機種。

頂規吸力與活水滾筒洗地系統

在核心清潔能力方面，作者指出 T90S Pro 將風機模組大幅升級至 40,000 Pa 超大吸力，風量達到每秒 16.45 公升。拖地模組則採用 OZMO Roller 加壓活水洗地技術，透過機身內建的加壓水泵與 16 個出水孔分化出的 32 道加壓水路，搭配每分鐘 260 轉與 3,000 Pa 下壓力，能即時邊拖邊洗滾筒。此外，機身支援 70 度熱水洗地 與沿邊自動伸出滾筒貼邊清潔，滾筒結構更改為快拆設計，清潔維護更加便利。

旗艦級底座自清潔與智慧排污

針對滾筒機種容易產生的異味與污垢問題，T90S Pro 不僅保留了污水盒內部 6,000 轉螺旋槳自清潔設計，更驚喜下放了旗艦專屬的「巨浪」高壓底盤自清潔系統。該系統能透過底座一整排水孔噴出高達 26,000 Pa 的高壓水流，在回洗時直接沖刷底層泥沙塵垢，大幅降低以往底座容易積水發臭、需要頻繁手動刷洗的痛點。

精準避障與智慧清潔策略

在導航與避障表現上，作者展示了 T90S Pro 僅 9.5 公分的超薄機身，能靈活穿梭於低矮家具下。前側配備雙線結構光與 AIVI 3D 4.0 視覺避障模組，並附帶補光燈，即使關燈也能順暢運作。軟體層面具備高度智慧策略，例如遇到大顆粒垃圾時會自動抬升邊刷避免彈飛；偵測到大片污漬時則會主動抬升滾刷與邊刷，僅以滾筒深入拖洗兩次，並立即回洗滾筒以防二次污染，同時還貼心加入寵物友善增壓模式。

全方位的防纏繞、地毯守護與閃充續航

最後，作者翻轉機身檢視底盤結構，T90S Pro 採用側向導流防纏繞主刷與經典風刃邊刷，有效解決毛髮問題。針對地毯清潔，滾筒除了自動抬升 15mm 外，更首度下放滾筒保護罩，在地毯上全面覆蓋滾筒以達成徹底乾濕分離。越障能力支援單階 2.5 公分、雙階 4.9 公分；電力部分則導入軟包動力電池與氮化鎵充電模組的 PowerBoost Plus 閃充技術，回充 3 分鐘即可補充 10% 電量，實現無限續航，搭配集自動集塵、自動補水與自動添加清潔劑的全能基座，將清潔體驗推向新高度。

================================================

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解 MSI Cubi NUC AI+ 3MG 的迷你機身、連接埠與擴充設計，評估它是否適合辦公桌面或商用環境。
  • 掌握 Core Ultra 9 386H 的處理器、內顯與 AI 運算實測表現，以及低功耗設定下的效能特色。
  • 認識 Power Link 螢幕連動、Thunderbolt 4 與 PD 供電等實用功能，了解迷你主機如何融入日常使用。
  • 透過套裝機與準系統的差異及應用情境，協助判斷適合自己的選購方式。

摘要

迷你主機的設計與應用

作者介紹 MSI Cubi NUC AI+ 3MG，指出這款迷你主機採用 Intel Panther Lake 平台，體積小巧並提供多種連接介面。NUC 可用於家用娛樂、文書辦公、外接顯示卡，也能在商業場景中擔任產線控制或櫃檯設備。底蓋可用硬幣旋開，方便更換記憶體與 SSD；購買時則可選擇已配好零件與 Windows 的套裝機，或自行搭配零件的準系統。

機身與連接功能

主機約為 12×12 公分、重量約 540 克，金屬底蓋兼顧輕量化與散熱。前方提供 USB-C、USB-A 等連接埠，電源鍵整合指紋辨識；背面則有雙 Thunderbolt 4、雙 2.5GbE 網路孔與雙 HDMI，Thunderbolt 4 也支援影像輸出及 PD 輸入供電。作者並示範透過 HDMI 線材及相關設定啟用Power Link，讓使用者按下相容 MSI 螢幕的電源鍵時，也能一併喚醒主機。

螢幕連動與硬體規格

作者以 MSI QD-OLED 螢幕展示連動功能，並介紹其高更新率、HDR、USB-C 供電與 KVM 等特色。受測 Cubi NUC 搭載 Core Ultra 9 386H，採 Panther Lake 架構，具備 16 核心 16 執行緒與四組 Xe3 內顯核心，並支援 XeSS 3 與影格生成。測試機配備 32GB DDR5-5600 記憶體及 PCIe 4.0 SSD，整機功耗設定為 25W，底蓋的導熱墊與銅片則協助 SSD 散熱。

效能、遊戲與散熱測試

在 Cinebench R23 測試中，處理器單核心獲得 2099 分、多核心獲得 17102 分；作者指出，多核心表現約為前代 Ultra 9 288V 的 1.7 倍。3DMark Time Spy 得分為 3293 分；遊戲測試中，搭配 XeSS 3 影格生成，《電馭叛客 2077》平均約 89.3 FPS，《黑神話：悟空》平均約 73 FPS。壓力測試穩定度約 99%；極致模式下 CPU 約 65 度、噪音約 46 分貝，預設模式則更為安靜。

AI 能力與選購方向

這款主機內建最高 50 TOPS 的 NPU，並具備 Wi-Fi 7、雙 2.5GbE 網路孔，可透過 MSI Center 調整運作模式。作者認為，它適合影音播放、下載與文書辦公，也可依需求選擇不同處理器版本；若使用者希望自行沿用或挑選記憶體與 SSD，準系統會是另一種選項。影片最後，作者邀請觀眾留言交流，並提醒觀眾訂閱頻道與追蹤社群平台。

摘要

迷你主機的設計與應用

作者介紹 MSI Cubi NUC AI+ 3MG，指出這款迷你主機採用 Intel Panther Lake 平台，體積小巧並提供多種連接介面。NUC 可用於家用娛樂、文書辦公、外接顯示卡，也能在商業場景中擔任產線控制或櫃檯設備。底蓋可用硬幣旋開，方便更換記憶體與 SSD；購買時則可選擇已配好零件與 Windows 的套裝機，或自行搭配零件的準系統。

機身與連接功能

主機約為 12×12 公分、重量約 540 克，金屬底蓋兼顧輕量化與散熱。前方提供 USB-C、USB-A 等連接埠，電源鍵整合指紋辨識；背面則有雙 Thunderbolt 4、雙 2.5GbE 網路孔與雙 HDMI，Thunderbolt 4 也支援影像輸出及 PD 輸入供電。作者並示範透過 HDMI 線材及相關設定啟用Power Link，讓使用者按下相容 MSI 螢幕的電源鍵時，也能一併喚醒主機。

螢幕連動與硬體規格

作者以 MSI QD-OLED 螢幕展示連動功能，並介紹其高更新率、HDR、USB-C 供電與 KVM 等特色。受測 Cubi NUC 搭載 Core Ultra 9 386H，採 Panther Lake 架構，具備 16 核心 16 執行緒與四組 Xe3 內顯核心，並支援 XeSS 3 與影格生成。測試機配備 32GB DDR5-5600 記憶體及 PCIe 4.0 SSD，整機功耗設定為 25W，底蓋的導熱墊與銅片則協助 SSD 散熱。

效能、遊戲與散熱測試

在 Cinebench R23 測試中，處理器單核心獲得 2099 分、多核心獲得 17102 分；作者指出，多核心表現約為前代 Ultra 9 288V 的 1.7 倍。3DMark Time Spy 得分為 3293 分；遊戲測試中，搭配 XeSS 3 影格生成，《電馭叛客 2077》平均約 89.3 FPS，《黑神話：悟空》平均約 73 FPS。壓力測試穩定度約 99%；極致模式下 CPU 約 65 度、噪音約 46 分貝，預設模式則更為安靜。

這款主機內建最高 50 TOPS 的 NPU，並具備 Wi-Fi 7、雙 2.5GbE 網路孔，可透過 MSI Center 調整運作模式。作者認為，它適合影音播放、下載與文書辦公，也可依需求選擇不同處理器版本；若使用者希望自行沿用或挑選記憶體與 SSD，準系統會是另一種選項。影片最後，作者邀請觀眾留言交流，並提醒觀眾訂閱頻道與追蹤社群平台。
